title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Bruno Martin
text:
Overall, the service and staff at The Kingsbury Colombo are excellent. The team is very professional, efficient, welcoming, and always helpful.

The room was beautiful and well maintained, and the bathroom was also very nice. The hotel offers valet service, which is very convenient. The gym is well equipped, and the breakfast buffet is excellent, with very good food and a wide variety of choices.

However, the major issue was the noise in the room. It was extremely noisy, and it was impossible to sleep properly. From the room, we could clearly hear cars, buses, and traffic from outside throughout the night.

For a hotel of this standard, the soundproofing of the windows really needs to be improved. It is a shame, because everything else was very good, but not being able to sleep in the room is a serious problem.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Bruno,

Thank you for your detailed feedback. We are pleased to know that you enjoyed certain aspects of your stay with us and your kind words about our team, dining, and facilities are sincerely appreciated.

Please accept our apologies for the disturbance caused by external noise during your stay. We understand how important a restful night’s sleep is, and your comments have been noted and shared with the relevant teams for review.

We truly appreciate your constructive feedback and hope to welcome you back for a more comfortable experience in the future.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Praveen Kumar Thiruvengadam
text:
Colombo has no shortage of luxury hotels, but The Kingsbury earns its place on the waterfront with quiet confidence. From the moment you walk in, the staff sets the tone — genuinely courteous, not performatively so. They remember your name, anticipate your needs, and do it all without hovering. That alone is worth the premium.

The food spread is where the hotel truly shines. Breakfast is a glorious, indulgent affair — the kind where you go back three times and still regret missing something. Local Sri Lankan dishes sit alongside international staples, and everything is executed with care. Room service matched that standard without drop-off — hot food arrived hot, cold food arrived cold. Revolutionary? Perhaps not. Consistent? Absolutely.

The pool is a gem — well-maintained, visually striking against the Colombo skyline, and refreshingly clean. It's the kind of pool that earns its own Instagram moment. The rooms themselves are spotless, well-appointed, and the beds deliver that particular brand of hotel-sleep that feels engineered for rest.

Location, of course, is half the story. Waterfront positioning, minutes from Fort and the city's commercial pulse — you're staying *in* Colombo, not beside it.

Now, the two small notes of discord: the corridor leading to the rooms carries a stubborn mix of beer and stale cigarette — jarring against an otherwise pristine experience, and something better ventilation could fix overnight. And the pool DJ? He's working with a pendrive on a three-track loop. By the second afternoon, you'll know the setlist by heart.

Minor gripes, honestly. The Kingsbury delivers strong value for what it charges — comfortable, central, and genuinely well-run. Come for the view, stay for the breakfast, and bring your own playlist.

⭐⭐⭐⭐ — *Four stars, nearly five.*
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Praveen,

Thank you for your thoughtful review. We truly appreciate your kind words and are delighted to know The Kingsbury made such a strong impression during your family stay. It is especially rewarding to hear that our service, dining experiences and location contributed to a memorable visit.

We also appreciate your constructive observations, which have been noted for review as we continue to refine the guest experience.

Thank you once again for your feedback and we hope to welcome you back for an enjoyable experience.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Suranga Perera
text:
I attended the Mother’s Day high tea buffet at The Kingsbury Colombo with my family after making a reservation. Unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing.

When we arrived, it appeared the hotel had accepted more bookings than they could accommodate. There was a long queue and we had to wait over 30 minutes. Even after raising concerns, the staff eventually took us inside but were still unable to provide proper seating arrangements.

What was most upsetting was that my family was asked to move from tables on two separate occasions. The banquet manager and staff seemed completely unorganized and unsure of how to handle the situation. I also attempted to make a formal complaint and requested to meet the GM, but this was refused, and later I was informed that the GM was in hospital.

In the end, we left the hotel without receiving any proper response or apology. It was a very disappointing experience and far below the level of professionalism expected from a five-star hotel.

There are many other places in Colombo where families can enjoy a peaceful dining experience with a much warmer welcome. Sadly, this was not one of them.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Suranga,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.

We sincerely apologise that your Mother’s Day High Tea experience did not meet expectations. We sincerely regret the disappointment caused and understand how important it is for such events to be handled with care and organisation.

Your concerns have been reviewed internally and addressed with the relevant teams to improve our event coordination and guest handling moving forward.

We would appreciate the opportunity to connect with you and host you with greater care should you choose to visit The Kingsbury again. Kindly contact us at daminda@thekingsburyhotel.com or call +94 77 301 8852, so we can assist you directly.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Sajad Rahimi
text:
Extremely awful experience at The Kingsbury Colombo.

The hotel rooms smelled really bad, which already made the stay uncomfortable, but the worst part was the nonstop loud music playing until around 10:30–11:00 PM every night. I was absolutely exhausted after a long day and desperately needed rest, but the music completely ruined any chance of sleep. Even after the music stopped, I couldn’t fall asleep properly because of how frustrated and drained I was.

I called the front desk multiple times hoping they would do something about it, but I was completely ignored. No solution, no apology, nothing.

If you are tired, need peace and quiet, or simply want a proper night’s sleep, forget this hotel. This place is not for you.
responseFromOwnerText:

We truly appreciate you bringing this to our attention and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a much improved stay in the future.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

textTranslated:
Overall, it was very good.
To put it positively, it's traditional and dignified; to put it negatively, it's an old building.
Although the building is old, the interior and bathrooms are clean and pleasant.
There was piano music playing in front of the reception, and people in traditional attire, perhaps for a wedding or something. The moment you enter the hotel, you get a strong sense of being on a trip abroad.
If I ever come to Sri Lanka again, I would like to stay here again.
responseFromOwnerText:

We truly appreciate your kind words and pleased to know you would choose to stay with us again on your next visit to Sri Lanka.

name: H (Joy)
text:
Reviewing the afternoon tea experience as well as the happy hour experience.

Afternoon tea:
buffet selection of various salty and sweet dishes. Some things are good, some not so good. However, the price is not expensive, so it's acceptable. The drinks (soft drinks and tea) are included, so that's nice.
Staff is quite stressed here, but still was told off since ice cream is extra price and not included.

Happy hour at the bar:
The happy hour has 4-5 cocktails with title only. When the bartender explained one of the cocktails, he neglected to mention it has celery in it. For the 1+1 cocktail you are not allowed to change your order for the 2nd cocktail, so I was stuck with the same cocktail, sans celery at least.

The price also did not not mention tax until the bill, which was a novel experience for Sri Lanka.
responseFromOwnerText:

As soon as we informed Charmaine, she took immediate action and arranged everything seamlessly, without any hassle. This level of commitment added immense value to our special day and gave us complete peace of mind.

The venue itself looked absolutely stunning, the service was impeccable, and our guests were thoroughly impressed. The food was another highlight—beautifully presented, delicious, and widely praised by everyone who attended.

The entire team ensured that even the smallest details were taken care of, allowing us to truly relax and enjoy every moment. We are incredibly grateful to The Kingsbury Hotel, and especially to Charmaine, for creating such unforgettable memories.

We highly recommend this venue to anyone planning a wedding or special event in Colombo

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Aravind Kumaranswamy
text:
We recently stayed at The Kingsbury Hotel with our family, and honestly, we were so touched by the warmth and kindness we experienced. Sri Lankan hospitality really surprised us in the best way possible.

From the moment we arrived, everyone—from the doormen to the restaurant staff—was so friendly and always ready to help with a smile. It really made us feel welcome.

A big thank you to Chef Jayasingha for helping us choose what to eat. The food was absolutely delicious and, in our opinion, much better than other nearby hotels we tried.

Our room was clean and well looked after by the housekeeping team, though we felt a little renovation and repainting could make it even better. We stayed on the 9th floor and were lucky to have a sea view room—the view was just amazing! The staff on that floor were also very kind and helpful whenever we needed anything.

Special thanks to Gunawardene for quickly helping us with bathroom items. And a huge thank you to Nabeel—he was incredibly helpful throughout our stay. He spoke both English and Tamil fluently, which made things so much easier for us. We probably bothered him quite a lot with our calls and questions, but he was always patient and kind. Thank you, brother, if you’re reading this!

Mangala, our bellboy, was also great and helped us with our luggage without any hassle. And Hairnath from the churros section—such a kind and friendly person!

Overall, we had a really wonderful stay and felt genuinely cared for. Thank you to the entire team for making our family trip so memorable.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Aravind,

Thank you for your review. We’re truly pleased that you and your family felt warmly welcomed and experienced the genuine hospitality of our team throughout your stay. It’s pleasing to hear that our team helped make your visit memorable and we will certainly share your appreciation with them.

We also appreciate your constructive note regarding the room, and your feedback has been noted as we continuously work on enhancing our facilities.

It was a pleasure hosting you and we look forward to welcoming you back soon.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

text: 酒店位置绝佳，海景房视野开阔，印度洋美景尽收眼底。房间宽敞整洁，床品舒适，设施现代化，WiFi速度快。工作人员服务专业热情，从入住到退房都高效贴心，特别感谢客房部的细心服务。餐饮选择丰富，早餐丰盛美味，亚洲主题餐厅令人惊喜。泳池和水疗中心是放松身心的好去处。不过入住时稍有等待，但瑕不掩瑜。整体体验出色，性价比不错，适合追求品质的旅客，下次来科伦坡还会选择这里。
textTranslated: The hotel boasts a superb location, with ocean-view rooms offering panoramic views of the Indian Ocean. The rooms are spacious and clean, with comfortable bedding, modern facilities, and fast Wi-Fi. The staff are professional and enthusiastic, providing efficient and attentive service from check-in to check-out; a special thank you to the housekeeping department for their meticulous service. The dining options are plentiful, with a delicious and abundant breakfast, and the Asian-themed restaurant was a delightful surprise. The pool and spa are great places to relax and unwind. While there was a slight wait during check-in, it didn't detract from the overall experience. Overall, it was an excellent experience with good value for money, suitable for travelers seeking quality accommodations, and I would definitely choose this hotel again on my next trip to Colombo.

text:
Kingsbury is one of the most beautiful hotel  in Colombo. Whenever we get the chance, we go there to enjoy its beauty and also to have delicious food and drinks. Their Honey Beach Club is a great place to have some fun with friends. Likewise, the food and drinks in the restaurants there are very fresh, clean, and delicious. It's a great place for you to have breakfast, lunch, or dinner, or to enjoy high tea. Also, the friendly staff will make you feel comfortable there. I also fondly remember the service I received from my telephone assistant, Dhammi. We have been here several times already and hope to go again in the future.
If you want to enjoy a dinner buffet/lunch buffet, you can go to The Harbor Court  Restaurant, which has beautiful and delicious food. You can enjoy delicious Cake ,desserts, savory items, delicious iced coffee, tea, and coffee, drinks at Churros Cafe. Also, a high tea Platter or high tea buffet is served here. If you want Chinese food, you can choose YUE CHUAN Restaurant, and if you like seafood, you can choose OCEAN Restaurant. If you need to chill out with friends, Honey Beach and Sky Lounge are located at the Kingsbury Hotel for you. We would like to especially mention Ms. Arusha Katz, who plays the piano in the lobby of the Kingsbury Hotel. She delighted us with her beautiful piano playing and we will always remember her kind and friendly manner. It was truly a sight to behold with her smiling face playing the piano. Also, all the staff we met here were very friendly.

Overall, we had a fantastic experience and absolutely loved our time here. Looking forward to coming back again soon! 🌟

Dear Kingsbury Hotel Management,

I have visited your buffet many times in the past and always considered it one of the best in Colombo. Unfortunately, our experience on the night of 15th March was extremely disappointing.

Many food items were not tasty at all, and several dishes lacked quality. The mutton dish had mostly bones with very little meat, and the chicken dishes were also poor in quality. The service was very slow—we waited nearly 20 minutes before a waiter came to take our drink order.

At the Indian corner, naan was available but only paneer was served, with no meat options. In the Chinese section, the chilli chicken had many bones, which is unusual for that dish, and the beef dish was also below standard. The dessert section was very limited and disappointing.

This was completely unexpected from a hotel of your reputation. Based on this experience, I would not consider visiting the buffet again and would not recommend it to others unless significant improvements are made.

I hope the management will seriously review and improve the quality and service to the standard it maintained earlier.

text:
Nice place to stay when you visit Colombo. The hotel has a huge parking garage close to the hotel if you come by car.

Rooms are small, carpeted floor, unfortunately, but the bathroom is fantastic with (too) many mirrors inside. AC works fine, but stop functioning when you remove the room key. You know what to do 🤫.

Best of all is the breakfast at the hotel. Here you can choose from more dishes than you care for, both hat and cold meals. And you are served by polite and friendly staff like Mathavan and Cham. We have been to many different hotels on this trip; The Kingsbury has the best breakfast so far.

If you can stand the heat, it is walking distance to the local market, but you may get a tuc tuc for less than 500 LKR, which is a much better way 😉.

There is also a shopping mall near by if you like buying famous brand name articles. Bookshop offers a lot of books in English by known writers. Plenty of eating place in the mall.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: dorothy wicks
text:
We stayed at the kingsbury hotel in jan/ feb this year for a total of 15 nights. We were very happy and comfortable throughout. We stayed in about 3 rooms since our 15 night stay was on 3 different bookings since we also travelled outside colombo during our stay in colombo. Each time we had rooms overlooking Galle face / sea which gave us great views. I need to thank Mr Tharaka Senaratne for his service and care in ensuring we receive the rooms of our choice.
A special mention goes out to Mr Pradeep Perera for his service and care and in retrieving a very special bit of jewellery  that my daughter accidently left behind at a hotel in unawatuna where we were staying. Mr Perera and staff member Mohammed ccontacted Mr Mangala Kumara ( concierge staff) who was in galle at that time and requested him to pick up this item of jewellery  from the hotel in unawatuna and bring it to us to the Kingsbury Hotel. My daughter was delighted to get back her jewellery.  Thanks Mr Pradeep, Mr Mohammed and Mr Mangala for your care and kindness. Such grest service which will not be forgotten.  The hotel made us feel it was home.
The housekeeping and reception staff were excellent. Service provided with  a smile and care always.

Another special mention  to staff member Gethika at Yue Chan restaurant.  We hosted a small party for  family and friends on the  18th jan. Geethika ( apologise if i have misspelt his name) helped us choose the menu . His service  throughout the dinner was exceptional. Thanks Geethika.  The food was delicious too.

We enjoyed the drinks and food at  some of the other restaurants at the hotel.
The breakfast buffet was very good  in particular the srilankan meals. However the pastries and cakes  did not meet  our expectations.
Finally i will add that  on our next  visit we will return to tge Kingsbury  even for a couple of nights. .very  conveniet location too. Thanks to all the caring and efficient staff
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Dorothy,

Thank you for your review. We are truly delighted to know that you and your family had a comfortable and enjoyable time with us.

We truly appreciate you recognising Tharaka, Pradeep and the rest of the team for their assistance. Your compliments will certainly be shared with them.

Your feedback regarding the pastries and cakes has been noted and shared with the relevant team for review. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we look forward to welcoming you back to The Kingsbury.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

name: Matteo Schmid
text:
I recently stayed at The Kingsbury Hotel in Colombo, and overall it was a decent experience. The location is definitely one of the biggest advantages of this hotel. It is very close to Galle Face Green and offers easy access to many attractions, restaurants, and shopping areas in Colombo.

The room was clean and reasonably comfortable, although some parts of the furniture and bathroom felt slightly outdated. The housekeeping staff did a good job maintaining cleanliness throughout our stay. The bed was comfortable enough for a good night’s sleep.

Breakfast had a good variety of local and international options. While the selection was impressive, the taste of some dishes was average rather than exceptional. The restaurant staff were polite, though service during busy hours felt a bit slow.

The rooftop area and pool were nice, offering a pleasant view of the ocean. It’s a good place to relax in the evening. However, the pool area can get crowded at times.

Overall, The Kingsbury is a good hotel with a great location and decent facilities. It may not feel extremely luxurious in every aspect, but it provides a comfortable stay in Colombo.

Very disappointing experience at The Kingsbury Colombo.

We made dinner reservations to celebrate my father’s birthday, expecting a special and memorable evening. Unfortunately, the experience was ruined when a staff member suddenly approached us and stopped us from taking photos with our camera. There was no prior notice about any restriction, and the way it was handled felt abrupt and unprofessional.

It was a personal family celebration — not a commercial shoot — and we simply wanted to capture memories of my father’s birthday. Instead, we were left feeling embarrassed and upset. Special moments like these cannot be repeated, and it’s extremely disappointing that a hotel of this standard lacks flexibility and basic understanding during such occasions.

Policies are understandable, but hospitality and communication matter even more. Sadly, this experience did not reflect the level of service expected from a 5-star hotel.
responseFromOwnerText:

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the disappointment you experienced during what should have been a very special celebration for your father’s birthday. We are truly sorry that the situation was handled in such a manner. This is certainly not the experience we wish any of our guests to have.

Your comments have been taken very seriously and will be reviewed with the relevant team to ensure this is addressed appropriately.

We would greatly appreciate the opportunity to learn more about your experience. Kindly contact us at tashya.p@hayleysleisure.com with further details, so we may investigate this matter thoroughly and respond to you directly.

Once again, please accept our sincere apologies. We hope to have the opportunity to restore your confidence in us in the future.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Angela
text:
We did not feel comfortable or truly welcome at The Kingsbury from the moment we arrived. The atmosphere was cold, but the incident at the pool bar was a total disgrace.

The Incident & The Scam at Honey Pool:
I paid 5,000 LKR for two drinks right at the barwaiter. Immediately, after i leave the bar and take a seat in the lounge, a second waiter appeared demanding payment. I'd say ro him that i pay directly to the waiter. The first waiter then lied, claiming I only gave him 1,000 LKR. It is not about the money; it is about the principle. Being treated like a liar by staff in a luxury hotel is insulting!

The Failure of Management:
We were stalled for 2 hours with excuses about "CCTV authorization," then told the "system was down," and finally promised the footage via email. More than 10 hours later, we heard nothing. They clearly waited for us to leave to avoid responsibility...

No Sleep & Noise:
To make matters worse, sleep was out of the question. The rooms are so poorly insulated that we heard every single noise and the loud music from the pool bar directly in our room. For a guest departing at 3:00 AM, this lack of rest combined with the stress of the scam was a nightmare!

The Final Insult:
At checkout, the staff didn't even ask how our stay was. They completely ignored the ongoing incident.

The Kingsbury has failed on every level—from basic honesty to providing a place to rest. AVOID at all costs!!!!!
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Angela,

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologise for the distressing experience you’ve described and want to assure you that your concerns are being taken very seriously.

Please be informed that we are conducting a thorough investigation into the matters raised and will provide you with a detailed response. In the meantime, we kindly invite you to reach out to us directly at tashya.p@hayleysleisure.com so we can assist you and address your concerns more promptly.

We appreciate your patience and understanding while we resolve this issue.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Paul Grimes
text:
The Kingsbury is a well appointed hotel in the centre of Colombo, not far from the seafront boulevard and several shopping malls.
Inside The Kingsbury, there are several restaurants and cafés as well as a couple of bars, one at the poolside and the skylounge rooftop bar with great views both day and night.  The skylounge also benefits from a cooling breeze, especially mid‐afternoon and the happy-hour 2-for-1 drinks kick in at 5pm.
On our last day we decided on a lunchtime drink at the rooftop Tenku Japanese restaurant and had an amazing meal for only £22 GBP per person. We chose the 'more expensive' tasting menu although the set menu for £10 GBP has some of the same dishes just smaller in overall number of dishes. Note, I think these are lunchtime special prices and may be dearer for an evening service.
We paired our dishes with a bottle of sake (several choices available at additional cost) from the large beverage menu and this really suited the dishes on the menu.  All in all a very filling meal but it meant no worrying about airport or flight cuisine for the rest of the day!
The Tenku restaurant itself is tastefully decorated in a reserved Japanese style and feels cool and welcoming after a morning exploring Colombo.
The insanely busy local market is some 10 minutes walk away, we felt safe when we walked through it and were not hassled too much, it's a real Sri Lankan experience!
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Paul,

Thank you for your wonderful review and for choosing to stay with us at The Kingsbury. We’re delighted that our central location and vibrant dining venues added to your Colombo experience.

It’s especially rewarding to know you enjoyed your visit to Tenkū and Sky Lounge. We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back for another memorable stay.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

text:
I agree with a previous traveller saying Elegant Hotel, Disappointing Guest Service.
It has been less than poor experience from the time reservation made.
We checked into the Hotel after a long day travel on 2nd Jan 2026 and the guest relations staff member barely smiled during the check in process. Since I extended my stay, he promptly charged me the extra amount and was given one key card. 1) Asked for another one to which he said, he'll issue next day morning which never happened. 2) from behind the desk he mentioned the where the elevator is and sent me on my way. Every other hotel we stayed in SL, either the staff member who checked us in or another one came with us to show our room. Did not tell us where the Pool is, what or how many restaurants were in the hotel, where they were located etc etc. Really poor service 3) When the elevator arrived, another staff member walked right past us into the elevator though we have been waiting for the elevator before she even arrived.
I was so disappointed once got into the room as we have been given a room on Second floor though I have paid for a premium. I thought of checking out the same night as I didn't feel welcomed. 4) Upon speaking to night shift Manager, he said he could give us a better room after two nights and when reminded on that day, they tell me "No sorry, we don't have rooms" Why isn't there any rooms when the Night shift manager said there will be rooms available because there are guests checking out? 5) Don't even get me started on Breakfast buffet. They don't seem to refill and staff clearly lack professionalism. So much disappointments at so many levels.
I decided to check out a day prior as we didn't enjoy the stay. I was charged extra at the check out to cover my extended stay. So, I needed to organise a refund. I am still waiting on my refund after 21days of checking out.
I agree with previous travellers' review. There are other better hotels in Colombo for less than what you pay to stay at Kingsbury for a much better guest experience. I have stayed at few different hotels. So, I know. Do yourselves a favour and book a different hotel. It's the staff that makes your stay enjoyable. And the staff here did not deliver.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: arshad zaid
text:
We visited Kingsbury Harbour Court for the lunch buffet to celebrate my brother’s birthday, and unfortunately the experience was extremely poor from start to finish.

The service was disorganized and unprofessional. When we tried to raise concerns, the manager was standing at the entrance, fully engaged in a conversation with a colleague, completely unaware and unresponsive—even while staff were calling him over for our complaint. When he finally engaged, there was no apology or ownership taken, neither from him nor from the staff.

The dessert counter was almost completely empty (around 90%) and remained that way for over 30 minutes. Even after we complained, it took another 20–30 minutes for items to be refilled. Similarly, at the pasta station, prawns were not refilled for over 30 minutes. Guests were expected to “adjust” due to poor organization in the kitchen, which is unacceptable at this level.

Food quality and hygiene were also major concerns. Several counters had long hair visibly present in the food. And the pasta counter Chef gives excuses as to saying it's guests. Where is the Hygiene and Safety Manager? The spread itself was extremely limited, with hardly any meat options. Dumplings were unavailable, and staff were unable to explain properly—one staff member rudely said “only one is available” without any clarity or courtesy.

The Thai noodle station was particularly disappointing—the staff member focused more on theatrics than actual cooking quality. At the pork station, one staff member appeared more interested in flirting with a colleague than attending to guests and disappeared after serving one portion. Despite seeing many chefs in the back, there was no coordination or efficiency.

The complimentary birthday cake, which was mentioned as part of the celebration, was later charged.

While a few waiters and hostesses were polite and helpful, overall the team lacked professionalism and proper training, especially in handling guest complaints. Staff simply ran to managers instead of listening or resolving issues—and unfortunately, management itself was a major letdown.

I rarely complain. I usually observe and guide, as I am a General Manager myself at a Marriott property. However, this experience was far below any acceptable hospitality standard. Even when compared to other local hotel buffets, this was one of the worst experiences.

I would not recommend Harbour Court to anyone, and I will not be returning.

To add to the disappointment, imagine having to pay for a “complimentary” birthday cake, and only having a single staff member acknowledge the celebration, no basic gesture, nothing but charged for a complimentary cake. At other hotels such as Shangri-La or ITC, even a minimal effort is made to recognize special occasions with a few team members singing along with you. Here, there was complete indifference. Honestly, it feels like it’s time for Kingsbury to consider handing this Hotel over to an international chain and building a proper service culture, because the current setup is chaotic. If a manager is unable to handle or even acknowledge a guest complaint, what can one realistically expect from the rest of the team? At one point, I asked a staff member who was serving water for a spoon—he disappeared for nearly an hour. I had to ask another staff member, who finally brought it. This level of basic service failure is unacceptable.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Arshad,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly sorry that your visit to Harbour Court did not meet expectations, especially on what should have been a special family occasion.

Please accept our sincere apologies for the disappointment you experienced. Your concerns have been taken very seriously and have already been reviewed in detail with the relevant teams. Immediate actions have been initiated to strengthen service oversight, improve buffet replenishment standards, and reinforce accountability and responsiveness across the team, with the aim of preventing any recurrence.

Guest experience, professionalism, and attention to detail are extremely important to us, and we regret that this was not reflected during your visit. Your feedback has been invaluable in highlighting areas that require urgent improvement.

Thank you once again for bringing this to our attention. We remain committed to raising our standards and delivering the level of hospitality our guests expect.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

While the food tasted good and the initial spread was quite impressive, the overall buffet experience did not live up to expectations for a hotel of this standard.

Many of the popular dishes were not properly refilled once they ran out. Several items that finished within the first hour were replaced with very basic alternatives, mainly sausages. At the start, there were two separate salmon dishes, but as they started to run low, they were combined instead of being freshly refilled. The same happened with the roast pork — by the time I went for a second serving, it had already been replaced with sausages, which was quite disappointing.

The dining area was extremely crowded, with tables placed far too close together, making the experience feel cramped and uncomfortable rather than relaxed.

Another letdown was the tea and coffee situation. Unlike most 5-star hotels where these are complimentary with a buffet, here they were not clearly included. To add to the confusion, different waiters gave conflicting information — some said tea and coffee were complimentary, while others said they were chargeable. This inconsistency was frustrating.

Overall, although the food quality itself was decent, the lack of proper replenishment, overcrowding, and unclear service policies took away from the experience. It does not reflect what one would expect from a 5-star hotel buffet.

text:
We had a very disappointing experience at the dinner buffet on 27-12-2025, particularly during the second buffet time slot (9:30 PM – 11:00 PM).

Although the buffet is advertised with two separate dinner slots, the service provided during the second slot was far below acceptable standards. Many food items were not refilled.

Specific issues we experienced include:
•	Multiple dishes were not refilled, and some were already taken back to the kitchen when we asked for them.
•	Soup buns and butter were unavailable initially and were only refilled in small quantities after repeated requests.
•	Sausages at the pork station were finished, and the staff informed us they would not be refilled.
•	Some staff members seemed unaware or unconcerned that there were two paid buffet time slots, creating the impression that the second slot was treated as a reduced or leftover service.
•	Around 10:45 PM, several items in the dessert section were already finished, with empty bowls left unattended and no attempt made to refill them. This is unacceptable, as the second buffet slot started at 9:30 PM, and all items should have been fully available and properly maintained throughout the duration of that time slot..
•	The ice cream station experience was particularly poor. It was covered, served by only one staff member, resulting in a very long queue.

If the restaurant is unable to provide the same quality and availability of food and service during the second buffet slot, it would be more appropriate to either remove that slot, reduce the price accordingly, or ensure proper service standards are maintained. It is also essential to clearly inform and train all staff about the existence and expectations of both buffet time slots.

Overall, this experience did not meet the expectations set by the buffet offering, and we hope management takes corrective action to improve service consistency and customer satisfaction.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Theo Hout
text:
Our three-week stay at Kingsbury Hotel Colombo, advertised as a 5-star hotel, was extremely disappointing.

The hotel is very noisy due to single-glazed windows, heavy traffic, nightly weddings with loud music, and ongoing construction inside the hotel, including drilling at night. We were moved four times without any improvement. Staff even refused to place us on the pool side, stating it would be even noisier.

We booked and paid for a sea side view, but the sea was barely visible. The actual view was a busy main road with traffic day and night.

The rooms were outdated and poorly maintained, with black mold, dirty carpets, no wardrobe space, broken furniture, and even a leaking sink. Towels were provided for only one person in a double room, requiring daily requests for a second set. Despite being labeled non-smoking, the corridors and rooms smelled strongly of cigarette smoke, and marble grinding inside the hotel caused dust and strong odors on our floor.

Breakfast service was far below standard. After the first two days, the coffee machine was “out of order” for the rest of our stay. Coffee had to be requested daily and was often lukewarm and incomplete.

Management made promises about compensation that were later denied at check-out. The spa experience was also mishandled, including receiving different treatments than booked and serious billing issues.

The serving staff were consistently very friendly and polite, but unfortunately this could not compensate for the many structural and management-related problems.

This hotel is misleadingly marketed as 5-star. Given the price paid, the experience was unacceptable. We strongly recommend choosing another hotel.
responseFromOwnerText:

We are truly sorry to learn that your experience did not meet your expectations. Please accept our sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused by external noise and the disturbance you encountered. As a city hotel located along a main thoroughfare, certain rooms may be affected by traffic sounds, and we regret that this impacted your comfort. Your comments regarding construction-related noise and room condition have been shared with our engineering and housekeeping teams for immediate review and corrective action.

We also regret that the sea view did not meet your expectations. While sea-facing rooms are positioned to offer partial views depending on location and surrounding developments, we understand how this could have been disappointing.

Regarding room amenities and housekeeping standards, please be assured that this feedback is taken very seriously. Maintaining our rooms to the highest standards is a priority, and we will be reinforcing quality checks to prevent such lapses.

Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve, and we sincerely hope you will consider giving us another opportunity to provide you with a more comfortable and enjoyable experience in the future.

The biggest disappointment, however, was the booking issue. I reserved a room for two persons including breakfast via Agoda for USD 120. During check-in, I was told that breakfast was not included. I was promised a call back from the reservation manager, but this never happened.
Basic aspects such as keeping agreements, flexibility, problem-solving, and professionalism were clearly lacking. No form of goodwill or compensation was offered. At check-out, I even showed that the exact same room could be booked online for USD 7 less, yet the only response was: “Sorry, we will do better next time.” Unfortunately, that does not help me.
Additionally, on the second day of Christmas there were many drunk locals around the hotel who were bothering guests, which further affected the overall experience.
All in all, the guest service was very poor, and we left with an empty stomach.
My wife and I would like to thank the hotel for this “wonderful” experience.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Patrick,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent stay with us.

We are pleased to note your comments about the hotel’s appearance and room cleanliness. However, we sincerely regret that your overall experience did not meet your expectations, particularly in relation to the booking details and service recovery.

With regard to the breakfast inclusion, we would like to respectfully clarify that the voucher received from the booking platform indicated a room-only reservation, with no meals included. Nevertheless, we understand how disappointing this situation must have been, and as a gesture of goodwill, lunch was offered at the time of check-out, which we hope provided some reassurance of our intent to assist.

We regret that the follow-up communication and resolution during your stay did not meet the level of responsiveness and flexibility you expected. This is certainly not the standard of professionalism we aim to deliver, and your comments have been shared with the reservations and front office teams for review and improvement.

Your feedback regarding disturbances during the festive period and the dining experience has also been noted with concern. Peak holiday periods can present challenges, but guest comfort and safety remain our priority, and we continue to strengthen our controls and service coordination during such times.

We truly regret that we were unable to provide a more positive and memorable experience on this occasion. Constructive feedback such as yours is valuable to us, and we appreciate the opportunity to review and enhance our service standards.

Warm regards,

We dined at Harbour Court on the 16th of December for dinner, and I must congratulate the Executive Chef and his team for the exceptional cuisine presented on the buffet. The food was flavourful and truly delicious.

The cold section was my personal favourite, the fresh salads, cheeses, sauces, and dressings were outstanding. The live pasta counter, offering a wide variety of choices, was another highlight. Equally commendable was the excellent service provided by the waiting staff. We were also pleasantly surprised by the beautiful voice of the gentleman who sang “Happy Birthday.” Unfortunately, I was unable to note his name, but I presume he was part of the management team.

We have been dining at Harbour Court frequently and have never been disappointed. Once again, a big thank you to the entire service and production team for a memorable dining experience.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Abhishek Goel
text:
I would like to sincerely appreciate the outstanding customer service provided by Hotel Kingsbury, Colombo, especially during an unexpected and difficult situation.

I had a confirmed booking that unfortunately fell under the non-refundable cancellation timeline. However, due to a severe cyclone situation, my travel plans had to be cancelled purely for safety reasons and were completely beyond my control.

Despite the strict booking policy, the hotel team showed remarkable empathy, understanding, and professionalism. After explaining my situation, the hotel went above and beyond standard policy and processed a refund, which was truly unexpected and deeply appreciated.

I would like to specially mention Mr. Balasurya, who handled my request with exceptional patience and care. His prompt communication, clarity, and genuine willingness to help reflect the true spirit of hospitality. It is rare to see such customer-centric thinking, especially when policies clearly allow otherwise.

This experience has reinforced my trust in Hotel Kingsbury, and it clearly demonstrates that the hotel values guest safety and long-term relationships over rigid rules. Such service builds loyalty, and I will certainly consider Hotel Kingsbury for future stays in Colombo and recommend it to others.

Thank you once again to Mr. Balasurya and the entire Kingsbury team for setting a high benchmark in customer service.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Abhishek,

Thank you for your thoughtful review. We are delighted to hear our team was able to go beyond the extra mile to cater to your needs. Your kind recognition is truly valued and we will be sure to share your appreciation with the team.

We look forward to welcoming you to The Kingsbury.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

Although we had proof and confirmation they repeatedly told us the funds hadn't gone through. They then charged us again for our stay. We also got food poisoning, I suspect from the cafe or the buffet. This hit us at the end of our flight to Singapore and we hadn't consumed anything else in that time so it was from one of the places at the hotel. We have contacted the kingsbury regarding this, and also some items we suspect we had left in our room, but have heard no response now 5 days since departure. Extremely disappointed and will not be returning. If the hotel had responded to our queries about our belongings and food poisoning experience I would not be leaving this review.

We are equally concerned to learn of your comments regarding the food and your health after departure. Kindly note that we take such matters very seriously and would like to investigate this further with our culinary and hygiene teams.

Additionally, regarding your lost items there have not been any records in our lost and found items registry, and payment issue, we have checked with our vendors and no payments received from your end hence we have processed the preauthorization taken from you at arrival.

Your experience does not reflect the standards we strive to uphold at The Kingsbury, and your feedback will be addressed immediately with the relevant departments to prevent any recurrence.

We truly value your comments and the opportunity to improve. Should you be open to further communication, please contact us at daminda@thekingsburyhotel.com so we can personally follow up and make amends.

Best regards,
Daminda Jayawardena
Director Front of House

name: Sam
text:
I and my family had a wonderful stay at The Kingsbury in Colombo. The hotel boasts a breathtaking view of the ocean and Galle Face Green, making it a perfect spot for both business and leisure travelers.

From the moment I arrived, the check-in process was smooth and efficient, handled by a team of very professional and well-trained staff. The room, although a bit dated in design, had all the essential amenities you'd expect from a 5-star hotel and was clean and comfortable.

One of the highlights was the massive breakfast spread—truly something for everyone. The only hiccup was receiving the wrong order at the live egg counter as the guy was busy talking. However, this was quickly and courteously rectified by a nearby steward, which once again demonstrated the high standard of service maintained by the staff.

In-room dining was another pleasant surprise—prompt, tasty, and reasonably priced, especially for a luxury hotel.

Overall, The Kingsbury exceeded my expectations. Highly recommended, and it will certainly be my preferred hotel for future visits to Colombo.

I celebrated my 25th birthday at The Kingsbury, in the Victorian Hall, and it turned out to be an absolutely wonderful experience. From the very beginning, Ms. Amritha de Silva was incredibly supportive — always just a text away, guiding and assisting me through every detail of the planning process. Her responsiveness, professionalism, and genuine care made everything so much easier and stress-free. I’m truly grateful for her constant support and coordination throughout.

On the day of the event, Mr. Kalhara, the event supervisor, was also extremely helpful and ensured everything ran smoothly. Any last-minute decoration or table arrangement was handled immediately — everything was just one call away.

For improvement, I’d suggest having brighter lighting in the changing room. Also, while the Victorian Hall can hold up to 180 guests, I personally feel that around 140 is ideal for a party like mine, as placing tables near the buffet area can feel a bit tight.

Overall, it was a five-star experience — the food was excellent, the service was attentive, and the entire team went above and beyond. My heartfelt thanks to Ms. Amritha de Silva and Mr. Kalhara for their exceptional support and dedication in making my 25th birthday celebration truly memorable.
I will share pictures once I get them from the photographer!

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Peri Inban
text:
The Kingsbury Colombo offers a luxurious and strategically positioned stay, right in the heart of the city with breathtaking views of the Galle Face Green and the Indian Ocean. The hotel’s prime location is its biggest asset—ideal for both business and leisure travelers looking to explore Colombo.

We were impressed by the warm and professional welcome at check-in and the overall attentiveness of the staff. The rooms are well-appointed, spacious, and feature modern amenities with large windows that make the most of the stunning sea or city views. The pool area is a highlight—well-maintained and perfect for unwinding.

Dining options are varied, from international buffets at The Spread to authentic Chinese cuisine at Shanghai. However, while the quality is generally good, some dishes lacked the standout flavor expected at this price point.

Service was mostly efficient, though during peak hours, the restaurant and lobby areas felt slightly understaffed, leading to minor delays.

Overall, The Kingsbury delivers a premium experience with its excellent location, comfortable rooms, and high standard of service. It’s a great choice for a stylish Colombo stay, though there’s room for refinement in consistency and dining excellence.

Ideal for: Luxury stays, business trips, romantic getaways, and sea-view lovers.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Peri,
Thank you for your feedback. We’re pleased to know you enjoyed your stay and appreciated our hospitality. We have noted your observations and will work on improving these areas to enhance our guest experience. We hope to welcome you back again soon.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

text:
スリランカに入って最初の投宿先です。ウェルカムドリンクで出迎えてくれました。たまたまボールルームでイベントがあったようで、華やかな衣装を着た人を見ることができました。正装した美しい人を見ることができたのは幸運です。こういうボールルームがあるっていうのが格式を感じさせます。

到着した晩、翌朝の食事はビュッフェでどれも美味しく頂きました。惜しくらむは機内食を食べ過ぎてしまったことです。分かっていたら機内食は自制してお腹を空かしておいたのだが、これは私がスケジュールをきっちり把握していなかったためです。

海外あるあるですが、シャワーの温度調整が難しいね。これもまた異国体験として楽しみました。この時点で既にウォシュレットが恋しくなっている！

翌朝から予定が詰まっていて、この界隈を歩けなかったのが心残りです。翌朝は雨だったというのもあって仕方なし。またの機会を待ちます。
textTranslated:
This was my first lodging in Sri Lanka. I was greeted with a welcome drink. It seemed there was an event going on in the ballroom, and I got to see people in gorgeous attire. I was so lucky to see such beautiful people in formal attire. The existence of a ballroom like this really adds to the prestige of the place.

The meals on the night of my arrival and the next morning were buffet style, and everything was delicious. My only regret is that I ate too much of the in-flight meal. If I had known, I would have refrained from eating in-flight meals and stayed hungry, but that was because I didn't keep track of my schedule.

As is often the case overseas, it's difficult to adjust the shower temperature. I enjoyed this as an exotic experience. At this point, I was already missing my washlet!

I had a packed schedule the next morning, so I regret not being able to walk around the area. It was unavoidable, especially since it rained the next morning. I'll have to wait for another opportunity.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Kalpi S
text:
The Kingsbury has really lost its charm, and it’s sad to see how much the quality has dropped over the years. This used to be one of the go-to places for cakes or high tea in Colombo, but now it’s completely the opposite. I honestly wouldn’t recommend it anymore—not even as a last resort.

Their so-called "Tiramisu High Tea" was one of the worst I’ve ever experienced. Almost everything was labeled “Tiramisu,” yet hardly anything tasted like it. They had “Tiramisu Date Pudding,” “Tiramisu Ice Cream,” and even a “Tiramisu Matcha Ice Cream” and so much more that just had crushed ladyfingers thrown in. One chef even insisted that “anything with ladyfingers counts as Tiramisu,” which shows just how little they understand about it. Out of the whole spread, only one dessert labeled 'Classic Tiramisu' carried a slight coffee flavor and came somewhat close to the real thing. The savory items were okay, but when you advertise a themed tea, it shouldn’t be carried by just one halfway-decent dessert.

The space itself is another problem in this hotel. The hall is so small and gets extremely overcrowded, especially in the hallways, making the whole experience feel chaotic and uncomfortable. On top of that, the service was disappointing—despite having a reservation, our table wasn’t ready, and we had to wait. To make things worse, some staff members were unprofessional, even trying to flirt with guests and asking for personal details while serving at the buffet. That kind of behavior is completely unacceptable for a hotel of this standard.

The cakes weren’t any better. We recently bought the Almond Cake and Oreo Cake, and both were terrible. The Almond Cake tasted like raw margarine with no almond flavor other than a few flakes stuck around it, and it left such a bad aftertaste that we had to throw it away. The Oreo Cake didn’t taste like Oreo at all, and both sponge cakes had the texture of rubber.

On top of all this, the staff seemed uninterested in guest feedback and lacked even basic cutlery etiquette.

The Kingsbury used to be a name people trusted for quality, but now it’s overcrowded, overpriced, and poorly managed. Sadly, it’s no longer worth the time, or money.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Kalpi,

Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback about your recent experience with us. We are truly sorry to learn that we fell short of your expectations. We sincerely regret that our themed high tea, cakes, and service did not reflect the high standards we strive for.

Please rest assured that we are addressing the issues you raised:
Our culinary team is revisiting the execution of our themed high tea menus to ensure authenticity and quality. Pastry items, including the Almond and Oreo cakes, are being re-evaluated for recipe consistency and taste. Service lapses, with regard to table readiness and professionalism, are being urgently reviewed with the team to ensure such behavior does not recur. Guest comfort is also a priority, and we are working on better space and crowd management for events such as high tea.

We truly value your candid observations as they help us improve. If you would allow us another opportunity, I would be happy to personally ensure your next experience reflects the true Kingsbury hospitality. Please feel free to reach me directly at  daminda@thekingsburyhotel.com.
 

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Dishi Servi
text:
Well planned family dinner with a Toddler - Ruined

I booked the dinner buffet for last Sunday dinner. In my first call I informed there will be 5 adults and a 3 year old toddler. Then the operator clearly told me the seating will be 6. (of cause it has to be we do not go to a 5 star hotel and keep our baby in the lap )
I requested a seating near the window since it'll be easy to keep the toddler distracted. I also requested 3x3 seating since our toddler behaves well while seated in between his parents.

The operator said in the call that she have put a special note with this info

I did this booking on Friday. On Saturday the baby's father informed me recently they went to the same buffet and they faced an unpleasant situ.  Once they went to the buffet there was no baby chair to the baby and staff said they should have specially requested for the chair - just informing we have toddler is not enough. and they got a baby chair with a little hustle.

Therefore I called again to make sure I mentioned the Baby chair.
during that call I again made sure the special note is there and operator reconfirmed me the details.

On Sunday I got two calls to reconfirm the booking from the Hotel(A guy and then a girl after approximately two hours apart). checked if the details are correct with them both time.

Finally when we arrived around 7.00pm. voilà.!!

-- A tiny female staff came, checked the booking by name, escorted us to a seating by window seat of 5 seating (No room for the baby)
-- Told her that's not the booking requested -  puzzled and annoyed face was shown to us.
-- Then she escorted us to a six seating 3*3 after I explained verbally (the employee not referring to the notes they took via calls) - this time no window seating.
-- I had to tell her that a six seating 3*3 window seating  was what requested;

*******
The staff told me I must have not communicated properly. I told her I did and also reconfirmed in the following calls. shook her head dismissing my claim. I requested her to refer the special note in the booking. she said she checked and there wasn't anything like that. I MUST NOT HAVE TOLD THEM IN WHEN MAKING THE BOOKING..!!!

At this point I was loosing my temper and I told her my calls are getting recorded and invited her to listen to them and show me in their booking system that there is no such information recorded as she's claiming (lying literally)

Mind you at least three 3*3 six person window seating  arrangements were vacant in the premises when this drama was unfolding.

Finally we were escorted to one of them with sour faced staff and baby chair arrived after reminding two three times.. :)

Poor food spread - details below

We had to wave like refugees for water refills since waiting staff just pass by without noticing when we wave.

The Cherry on top of the cake was one the staff who involved in the seating drama asking me if I enjoy their "service".

I wonder if these employees are bribed by rival hotels since  cinnamon lakeside/ life COD cuz we were all regretting not going there spending little extra and receive better service and food spread.

I've been to this place since it was Ceylon Continental, After rebranding to Kingsbury, to High tea, brunch, bar, Honey Beach many times and had a lot of pleasant memories here. but will never choose this place unless I'm a guest of someone else who chose this place.

I'm questioning the management on:

- Why your staff not attending the booking requirements made while making the appointment.???
- Why don't they read the special notes in the bookings?
- Why they are not asking the golden question if the guests need a baby chair for the baby when they mention there is a baby among the guests?? if they have a policy of only providing it on prior request?
- Why your Sunday  international dinner buffet don't have the must have staples like lamb, blue cheese. the cashew curry in Sri Lankan cuisine?

This will be the end of my visits to once glorious Kingsbury...!!

Never again..!!
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Dishi,
Thank you for your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that your recent experience did not meet expectations, and we sincerely apologise for the shortcomings in service and communication you encountered. Please be assured that your comments have already been reported to the relevant teams and corrective action has been taken.

We hope you will consider giving us another opportunity to provide you with the level of service and hospitality we are known for.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Nadeem Husain
text:
Review: Exceptional Staff & Service at The Kingsbury Hotel, Colombo

Our recent stay at The Kingsbury Hotel was made truly memorable, not just by the beautiful property and amenities, but by the outstanding service delivered by every member of the staff. Each person went above and beyond to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience for our entire group.

Mahesh, Assistant Manager of Guest Services at reception, welcomed us warmly and managed all front-desk matters with professionalism and a personal touch.

At Harbour Court Restaurant, Niroshan and Francis stood out with their hospitality and attention to detail, allowing us to enjoy our meals in absolute comfort and care.

Up at the Sky Lounge, Asela and Devan provided exceptional service, always ready to accommodate our ideas and adjust plans to ensure everything was perfect.

Dilution, the General Manager of F&B, was a pillar of support—always available, accommodating, and proactive in addressing our needs and last-minute changes.

Feroz, who handled our room reservations, was incredibly diligent. His coordination gave us peace of mind, ensuring all our arrangements were perfectly in place with no hassle.

At Kings Bar Steak Room, Kavasha was super prompt in responding to our requests and event customisations. We received two days of smooth, stress-free support, thanks to his efforts.

Mohd Amjad, the Night Manager at Reception, made late-night check-ins a breeze. His soft-spoken, humble nature helped all our guests feel at ease, no matter the hour.

Irshad, the bellboy, was the first to welcome us—and left a lasting impression. His friendly demeanor, timely service, and helpful insights into the hotel and its facilities set the tone for our stay.

And finally, Shukri truly amazed us during the checkout process. Managing a large group, he remained calm, efficient, and impressively quick in organizing all necessary documents. His patience and execution were remarkable.

In summary, The Kingsbury team delivered a masterclass in hospitality. From check-in to check-out, every staff member played their role exceptionally well, leaving us with only praise and gratitude. We look forward to returning soon.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nadeem,
Thank you for your detailed and thoughtful review. We are truly delighted to hear that our team members made your visit memorable through their dedication and warm hospitality. Your kind recognition of their efforts means a great deal to us, and we will be sure to pass on your compliments to each of them. We look forward to welcoming you for another exceptional experience.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

The ambience is sophisticated yet comfortable, and the service is warm and attentive. Perfect for a special dinner, family gathering, or even a business meal.

Highly recommend if you’re in Colombo and looking for an unforgettable buffet experience!

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: C S S Rao
text:
My wife, daughter with her two infants & self stayed at Kingsbury Hotel Colombo last week for 4 nights. (This hotel was formerly called the Ceylon Intercontinental & was known for some excellent Indian food).
Since we were 5 persons, we requested for a large premium room with an extra bed & this was provided at an extra charge.
The package included daily buffet breakfast , Free Wifi etc.
The Room was very clean & toilet large & spacious with good hot water. Beds were comfortable & bathrobes were provided . But strangely there was NO Stationary in the Room . Further the Room Service Menu had to be scanned with a QR Code. (These were negative points which did not speak well of a " Class Hotel".
We are vegetarians & though the Buffet Breakfast had South Indian items like Idli, Upma, Pongal , Vadai, Dosai etc with Sambhar & Coconut Chutney -sadly these dishes were bland, tasteless & had little resemblence to South Indian fiery chutneys & sambhar. Further menu remained unchanged (no pooris with potato curry etc) so it was very stereotyped. Further odly they had cold Naan Pieces with the tasteless north indian channa masala etc. Overall the South Indian dishes at breakfast were a flop . We tried the Chinese Restaurant, Honey Open Air , Churacao coffee shop , but found there was hardly any Vegetarian food (none Indian) & dishes were mild in taste. The Chinese restaurant dishes too were small in quantity.
It seems Kingsbury Hotel is not "Vegetarian Friendly & Not for taste loving South Indians".
Another shocking thing we noticed is there was NO 24 hrs Coffee shop serving dishes from all over the world. The catering dept of the Kingsbury was pedestrian & disappointing. (Surprisingly the best dishes were from Room Service - Grilled Veg Sandwich).
The service was very good , Staff extremely polite & helpful. The ambience would have been nice, but for large cricket team & other groups- coming daily & cluttering up the lobby with other functions.
Wifi in rooms was good & so was security . But it seemed some guest were smoking in their rooms- as the smell permeated to the corridor.
The Hotel can become a 5 star hotel if it revamps its Catering dept, provides authentic South Indian Veg dishes & caters to Vegetarians.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for sharing your feedback regarding your recent stay at The Kingsbury, Colombo. We are glad you found our team helpful, the rooms comfortable, and Wi-Fi and security satisfactory.

We appreciate your comments regarding vegetarian options and South Indian dishes, as well as suggestions on room stationery and dining services. These will be shared with our culinary and operations teams as part of our efforts to enhance the guest experience.

We hope to welcome you back and provide an even more enjoyable stay.

The Kingsbury, Colombo

Would definately not stay here again and I would recommend everyone to instead stay at Hilton, which is similarly priced in similar location.

All the staff were very friendly but for a 5 star hotel, the staff and service was extremely disorganised. In reception area, there were always 20+ staff around but no one knew what they were doing and simple requests took a long time to sort out. Reception ran out of key cards and therefore could not give us 2 per room. Additionally we had to get our card reprogrammed several times during iur stay.
Staff prioritised guests that were there to gamble at the associated casinos and treated other guests differently.

Same can be said for restaurants. At one morning buffet, I was asked 6 times by 6 seperate staff, if I wanted coffee/tea. However later on, we had to ask for water several times before getting any. Another time, we booked the seafood restaurant for the crab feast and had to tell 4 seperate staff that this is what we were ordering. The staff need proper training and management needs to understand the proper way to run a restaurant and organise staff.

Our room was on a non-smoking floor as requested, however the room above us were smoking in-room and this came through the air vents at night, making it impossible to sleep. We had to request to move rooms and this was accommodated, however very disorganised by reception and we had to ask several times throughout the day.

There were so many events occurring, that the hotel was consistently busy, and this was not a relaxing environment for guests. There was always loud club-like music playing at the pool and rooftop bar, even throughout the day, which again made it not relaxing for guests.

Rooms are very clean but quite old fashioned.

We went to the Kingsbury Hotel lunch buffet expecting a special, memorable time with my family who had flown in to Sri Lanka for the summer. Instead, what we experienced was nothing short of shocking. The moment we stepped in, I had to wonder, was this really the Kingsbury, or had we accidentally walked into a chaotic Pettah market?

The place was overcrowded beyond reason. There was no space to move, no breathing room, we felt suffocated. Despite having made a reservation, there was no table available for us. The buffet area was swarmed with people pushing in for food, while others queued outside and shouted in frustration.

The scene was appalling: food spilled on the floor, staff visibly overwhelmed, and the atmosphere more like a free-for-all dansala than a refined five-star dining experience. In all my life, I have never seen such disorder, let alone in a hotel that claims to be among Colombo’s best.

Utterly disappointed, we cancelled our reservation on the spot and left for dinner elsewhere. This was, without question, the most unpleasant dining experience I have ever had, and a stark reminder that a five-star label means nothing without five-star service and standards.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Sevinç Candan
text:
Wir verbrachten nur eine Nacht in diesem Hotel. Die Lage und Aussicht sind – je nach Zimmer – durchaus schön. Da wir keine Mahlzeiten im Hotel gebucht hatten, entschieden wir uns, das nahegelegene Einkaufszentrum aufzusuchen, um dort etwas zu essen.

Bereits etwa 100 Meter vom Hotel entfernt wurden wir von einer Person angesprochen, die laut eigener Aussage seit 25 Jahren in diesem Hotel arbeitet. Er empfahl uns, einen Juwelierladen (Gem Warehouse) aufzusuchen, der angeblich am letzten Tag einer grossen Rabattaktion stand. Fast zeitgleich näherte sich ein Tuk-Tuk, das uns dorthin bringen sollte – ein offenbar gut eingespieltes Vorgehen.

Im Juweliergeschäft bemerkten wir den Betrugsversuch rechtzeitig, kurz vor dem Bezahlen, und verliessen den Laden ohne einen Kauf zu tätigen. Kaum draussen, wartete derselbe Tuk-Tuk-Fahrer bereits wieder auf uns und versuchte, uns zum nächsten Geschäft (einem Teeladen) zu bringen. Dieses Angebot lehnten wir ab.

Es ist sehr bedauerlich, dass solche Erlebnisse das Image des Hotels trüben – insbesondere, wenn sie in unmittelbarer Nähe des Hauses stattfinden und unter dem Vorwand einer Verbindung zum Hotel vermittelt werden. Ich möchte dies ausdrücklich erwähnen, da derartige Vorkommnisse bei Touristen einen bleibenden negativen Eindruck hinterlassen können – auch wenn das Hotel an sich in Ordnung ist.
textTranslated:
We only spent one night at this hotel. The location and view are quite nice, depending on the room. Since we hadn't booked any meals at the hotel, we decided to go to the nearby shopping center to get something to eat.

About 100 meters from the hotel, we were approached by someone who claimed to have worked there for 25 years. He recommended we visit a jewelry store (Gem Warehouse) that was supposedly on the last day of a big sale. Almost simultaneously, a tuk-tuk approached, offering to take us there – an apparently well-rehearsed tactic.

At the jewelry store, we noticed the attempted scam just before paying and left without making a purchase. As soon as we were outside, the same tuk-tuk driver was already waiting for us again and tried to take us to the next shop (a tea shop). We declined his offer.

It is very regrettable that such experiences tarnish the hotel's image – especially when they occur in the immediate vicinity of the hotel and are presented as being connected to it. I feel compelled to mention this because such incidents can leave a lasting negative impression on tourists – even if the hotel itself is otherwise fine.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sevinç Candan,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.

We are glad you appreciated the hotel’s location, view, and service. However, we are truly sorry to hear about the unpleasant experience you had near the hotel with individuals misrepresenting a connection to us. Please rest assured that these actions are not affiliated with The Kingsbury, Colombo, and we take such matters very seriously.

Your feedback is valuable, and we will continue to work closely with local authorities and partners to ensure the safety and comfort of all our guests.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a more positive stay in the future.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Nuju Harley
text:
I’m writing this with genuine disappointment after what should have been a joyful family celebration turned into a frustrating and upsetting experience at Kingsbury Colombo. I took my family out for lunch to celebrate my brother’s wedding, expecting excellence based on Kingsbury’s name and reputation. Sadly, what we received was the complete opposite.

We paid LKR 4,700 per person for six people—this was not a casual meal or a discounted offer. It was a special treat for a once-in-a-lifetime occasion. I trusted Kingsbury to deliver a premium experience. Instead, we were met with poor service, disorganized staff, and unprofessional behavior.

From the moment we walked in, the experience was uncomfortable. The staff member at the restaurant entrance, Achini, greeted us with zero warmth or professionalism. Her attitude was dismissive and rude—definitely not what you’d expect from someone in a customer-facing role at a 5-star hotel. She clearly lacks the basic understanding of hospitality and customer care.

To make things worse, when I made the booking, I was specifically told that the hotel would provide a complimentary cake for the newlyweds. Even after more than two hours, no one mentioned it. I had to ask, and once again Achini responded with an unacceptable attitude—like it was an inconvenience for her. She didn’t even apologize for forgetting something that was part of the promise.

I’ve dined in many hotels across Sri Lanka—some even rated 2 or 3 stars—and received far better service than this. The Kingsbury name carries weight, and I truly believed they would make this family moment special. Instead, I felt embarrassed and disappointed in front of my family for choosing this place.

This is not just about bad service—it’s about failing a guest on a special day. Management seriously needs to retrain staff like Achini and review their internal standards, because if this is how guests are treated, it will only damage the hotel’s long-standing reputation.

I will not be returning to Kingsbury, and I cannot recommend it to anyone expecting professionalism, warmth, or value for money.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nuju,
Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We sincerely regret the shortcomings you experienced. Please accept our heartfelt apologies for the service lapses and the missed opportunity to make your occasion memorable. Your comments have been shared with our management team for immediate review, and we will take the necessary steps to ensure these concerns are not repeated. We value your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to restore your confidence in the future.

Warm regards,
Team Kingsbury

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Vishnupriyan Ramadas
text:
I recently visited this restaurant for their dinner buffet and had a fairly pleasant experience overall. The food was definitely the highlight of the evening. There was a wide variety of dishes available, and most of them were flavorful and well-prepared. From the appetizers to the desserts, everything seemed fresh and thoughtfully presented. I especially enjoyed the main course options, which offered a good mix of vegetarian and non-vegetarian items.

The ambience, however, was just average. The lighting and decor were basic, and while the seating was comfortable enough, the overall atmosphere didn’t feel particularly cozy or special. It felt more functional than inviting.

One downside was how crowded the restaurant was. It was a busy evening, and the place felt a bit cramped. At times, it was difficult to navigate between tables or get quick service due to the number of people. This did impact the overall dining experience slightly, especially when trying to go for refills at the buffet.

Despite that, if you're mainly looking for a good variety of tasty food at a reasonable price, this place delivers. I’d consider returning on a less busy night to better enjoy the meal and setting.

text: Très déçue, chambre avec moquette, pas de possibilité d'ouvrir la fenêtre pour une chambre fumeur. Mauvaise surprise ce n'est pas le cas et avons dû payer un buffet alors que nous aurions pu manger dans un autre restaurant à nos frais. On nous propose de nous servir le petit déjeuner en chambre comme nous devions partir à 3h du matin, finalement nous les avons récupérer à la réception, une bouteille d'eau, une pomme, une orange, un mini sandwich au fromage et un bâtonnet pané, pour un 5 étoiles... très bruyant le soir. Vue très moche sur le port. Seul intérêt le bar sur le toit terrasse, mais le happy hour n'en est pas un du tout.
textTranslated: Very disappointed. The room had carpeting, and there was no way to open the window, which is a problem for a smoking room. We booked through a tour operator and asked if dinner was included, as we were on half-board at all the hotels. We were directed to one of the hotel restaurants. To our dismay, it wasn't, and we had to pay for a buffet when we could have eaten at another restaurant at our own expense. They offered to serve us breakfast in our room since we had to leave at 3:00 AM, but we ended up collecting it from reception. It consisted of a bottle of water, an apple, an orange, a small cheese sandwich, and a breaded breadstick—for a 5-star hotel... It was very noisy in the evening. The view of the port was awful. The only redeeming feature was the rooftop bar, but the "happy hour" was a complete joke.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: K. M.
text:
The Kingsbury Colombo is a beautiful hotel, with an elegant and upscale atmosphere that makes it a lovely place to visit. We stopped by for their high tea, and while the setting was impressive, the overall experience was just okay. The tea itself was fine—good, but nothing particularly special in terms of variety or flavor. The high tea platters, while nicely presented, took 45 minutes to arrive, which felt quite long considering the setting and expectations.

Service was just okay. I had to ask multiple times for water refills and for items like milk for the tea, which really should be offered proactively in a high-end hotel. These small details—like refilling water without needing to ask—are what I would have expected at a place like The Kingsbury, but they were missing here.

That said, the ambiance is what makes it worth a visit. The hotel is gorgeous, and the pool area is especially nice. If you’re visiting, consider the pool day pass for $15 per person for 3 hours—it’s a great way to relax. The poolside tavern is a good spot for a drink or snack.

Overall, the high tea is decent but not exceptional. Worth it for the setting, but service could definitely be improved
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear K. M.,
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback with us. We’re pleased to hear you enjoyed the elegant atmosphere and beautiful setting of The Kingsbury, especially the pool area.

However, we sincerely apologise for the service shortcomings you experienced during the High Tea, particularly the delays and lack of proactive attention. Please be assured that we have already alerted the respective team to address these issues and improve our service standards.

We appreciate your balanced perspective and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future for a truly exceptional visit.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team
