title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Mike Thomas
text:
I have stayed in this hotel under different brands, from the renowned original IHG to Continental and then a newly renovated Kingsbury several years ago. Each of those stays I enjoyed the amazingly historical location: the hotel by the Indian Ocean, overlooking the former parliament and the Gall Face. The best stay was when Kingsbury was launched with the grand and very elegant renovations some 15 (?) years ago.
I have given only three stars for the location as the ugly reclaimed land has destroyed nature and the former beautiful setting of the hotel by the ocean. It’s such a shame as the hotel has certainly lost a large aspect of its prominence because of the reclamation.
The rooms have somewhat aged from my last stay but it’s understandable as if my recollection is right it would have been about 15 years ago since the Kingsbury was launched after extensive renovations. At that time the hotel provided exclusive international branded amenities which are no longer provided but totally understandable as the rates do not justify such costly features.
The F & B offers have increased and the breakfast is outstanding not only with the food offers but the people who deliver the renowned Sri Lankan hospitality. Chef Jayasinghe is an ambassador for the hotel with his caring and friendly attitude.
The general staff attitude is very positive, especially the junior staff such as housekeeping and lobby staff.
I would leave the Kingsbury with good memories and as the tag line says the hotel and its historic location is “forever timeless”. If I had the choice I would simply amend it to “ The Kingsbury” and  underneath, “Timeless”. “Timeless" already implies something that lasts forever or does not fade with time, so adding "forever" could be seen as redundant, reinforcing the idea rather than adding a new meaning. In effective marketing ,” less is more” but that’s just a detail.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mike Thomas,

Thank you very much for sharing your detailed and thoughtful review. We truly appreciate your loyalty over the years and your recognition of our staff’s dedication, especially Chef Jayasinghe and our junior team members. Your insights regarding the location and room conditions are invaluable, and we will certainly take your feedback into consideration as we plan future improvements.

Your suggestion about the tagline “Timeless” is also noted—sometimes simplicity does speak volumes.

We hope to welcome you back soon for another memorable stay.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: uthpala hasitha
text:
I recently stayed at The Kingsbury Colombo from April 2 to April 8, 2025, and I must say — every moment of my 7-day, 6-night stay was nothing short of exceptional. As a local living overseas, I was truly impressed by the world-class hospitality I experienced here.

From the very beginning, the concierge team stood out — they were incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional. Their warm attitude and impeccable service went far beyond my expectations, making me feel welcomed and valued throughout my stay.

Special thanks also to the housekeeping staff, who maintained my room perfectly. They were polite, efficient, and ensured that everything was clean and comfortable every day.

One unforgettable highlight was the in-room dining experience. I ordered the black pork curry with pol roti — and it was simply divine! Without exaggeration, it was one of the best meals I’ve ever had, full of authentic Sri Lankan flavor and prepared to perfection.

Overall, The Kingsbury Colombo exceeded all my expectations. The hotel is super clean, secure, and the staff make a genuine effort to create an exceptional experience for every guest. We are currently planning our annual holiday to Sri Lanka, and while writing our itinerary, I was reminded of a memorable , though mixed  experience from last year.

It has become a tradition for us to visit the Kingsbury Seafood Restaurant to enjoy our favourite crab curry with bread. However, during our last visit, we encountered a rather shocking situation that left us quite unsettled.

Upon arrival at the hotel, the person at the front entrance gave us an unpleasant welcome. His demeanor felt rude and uninviting, which was disheartening, especially since we had travelled specifically to enjoy this as a part of our trip. First impressions matter, excellence in hospitality begins with the welcome, not just the service that follows. Unfortunately, it seemed as though he was annoyed by our presence.

We understand that the hotel attracts a mix of guests, and perhaps there are concerns about locals are lingering around. However, it is unfair and inappropriate to judge anyone based on their appearance or background. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect and dignity, regardless of where they come from.

That being said, the restaurant staff and manager were exceptional, as always. They went above and beyond to make us feel like valued guests, turning the experience around with their warm hospitality and professionalism.

To this day, my husband still hesitates, wondering whether we should return or risk being made to feel uncomfortable again. I just wanted to share this experience in the hope that it encourages a more consistent and inclusive approach to guest service  from the entrance to the table.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ash,

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We are grateful for your continued patronage of The Kingsbury Seafood Restaurant and are pleased to hear that the restaurant staff and manager provided you with excellent service during your visit.

However, we sincerely apologise for the less-than-welcoming experience you had at the entrance. We strive to ensure that all guests feel valued and respected from the moment they arrive, and it is disheartening to learn that we fell short in this instance. Please be assured that we will address this matter with the relevant team to ensure that such experiences are not repeated.

We understand the importance of creating a warm and inclusive environment, and your feedback is invaluable in helping us maintain the high standards of hospitality we aim to deliver.

We look forward to welcoming you back to The Kingsbury and hope to provide you with a flawless experience on your next visit.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: gmarte m
text:
Oltre il lusso, serve altro…
Ho alloggiato in questo hotel a Colombo il 6 marzo. Arrivo, giornata libera con cena inclusa e partenza prevista il giorno dopo alle 6 del mattino per l’aeroporto.
Sapendo di non poter fare colazione seduta, chiedo con la mia guida se fosse possibile avere una semplice breakfast box da portare via. Nulla di complicato, due cosine per non partire a stomaco vuoto. La risposta? Non serve, può fare colazione tranquillamente alle 6 e partire alle 6.15. Questo è quello che mi assicura il signore più anziano della reception.
Peccato che la mattina dopo, alle 6, scendo e mi trovo davanti due ragazzi giovani che mi informano che la colazione non è servita prima delle 6.30. Spiego la situazione con il traduttore, ma parte una sorta di “conferenza stampa” tra loro. Dopo 5 minuti, mi portano finalmente al buffet, dove chiedo un semplice caffè e latte. A quel punto, si guardano tra loro come se avessi chiesto ostriche e caviale.
Risultato? Prendo un misero muffin e me ne vado, salutando con un bel bye bye.
Ora, vorrei far presente alcune cose:
1.	La colazione era pagata.
2.	Se non siete in grado di organizzare nemmeno questo, figuriamoci il resto.
3.	Santo cielo, non lavorate alla NASA!
Infine, un piccolo consiglio: con i prezzi che applicate, potreste almeno assumere qualcuno che parli due parole in italiano. Perché in Sri Lanka, persino nei posti più sperduti, trovi chi lo parla. Tranne nel vostro hotel.
Ovviamente, non consiglierò questa struttura e di certo non tornerò mai più.

Luxury is not enough…
textTranslated:
Beyond luxury, you need more…
I stayed at this hotel in Colombo on March 6th. I arrived, had a free day with dinner included, and was scheduled to leave the next day at 6:00 AM for the airport.
Knowing I couldn't have breakfast sitting down, I asked my guide if it was possible to get a simple breakfast box to take away. Nothing complicated, just a few things to avoid leaving on an empty stomach. The answer? No need, you can easily have breakfast at 6:00 AM and leave at 6:15 AM. This is what the older gentleman at the reception desk assured me.
Unfortunately, the next morning, at 6:00 AM, I went downstairs and was met by two young men who informed me that breakfast wasn't served before 6:30 AM. I explained the situation to the translator, but a sort of "press conference" ensued between them. After five minutes, they finally led me to the buffet, where I asked for a simple coffee and milk. At that point, they looked at each other as if I'd asked for oysters and caviar.
The result? I grab a measly muffin and leave, bidding a hearty goodbye.
Now, I'd like to point out a few things:
1. Breakfast was paid for.
2. If you can't even organize that, imagine the rest.
3. Good heavens, you don't work at NASA!

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Chethani Isurika
text:
Worst experience.

Yesterday, we came for my best friend’s bride to be party just six of us. We made a reservation at Honey Beach Club for six people. When we made the reservation, we clearly asked what would happen if it rained. They assured us that if it rained, they would arrange seating in an indoor area.

From the beginning, it was a terrible experience. When I arrived, I went to the restroom with my friend, and there were three ladies in black uniforms. They were shouting without any discipline and rudely asked me to move. It was very uncomfortable. Is that what hospitality looks like in a star-class hotel? We felt like we were in a street restaurant.

After that, we returned to our table. When my other friends arrived with a cake, no one provided a knife or a side plate until we asked for it. We did not expect such poor service from a hotel of this standard.

Then, it started to rain, and we wanted to place an order, but no staff members were available. We waited, and as the rain got heavier, no one took responsibility for the guests. Eventually, we moved inside, and at least the F&B staff acknowledged us, but where were the managers? I saw one person in a full suit, but he didn’t even smile at the guests.

To make matters worse, all our drinks got caught in the rain, and instead of replacing them immediately, they brought the drinks now mixed with rainwater back to our table. Can anyone drink that? We had to ask for new drinks, and only then did they provide them.

However, I want to appreciate one lady who helped us dry our clothes .her service was commendable.

I’m also a hotelier, which is why we chose this venue for such a special occasion, but it turned out to be the worst experience we’ve had at a star-class hotel. There were so many staff members in full suits perhaps managers but what’s the point of having them if they don’t lead their team or step in when guests are facing issues?

Why should we spend our money on this kind of service? But the food was very good.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Chethani,

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We deeply regret that your experience at Honey Beach Club did not meet the high standards you and your friends expected, especially on such a special occasion. Please accept our sincerest apologies for the discomfort and inconvenience you encountered throughout your visit.

It is concerning to hear about the lack of professionalism and service from our staff, especially in regards to the initial greeting, the handling of your cake, and the rain-related issues. This does not reflect the level of service we strive to provide at our establishment. The lack of proper communication and management during the rain, as well as the issue with the drinks, are areas we will address immediately to ensure this does not happen again in the future.

We truly appreciate your positive mention of the staff member who helped with your clothes. Rest assured, we will take your feedback seriously and review our procedures to improve service consistency, especially during unforeseen circumstances like weather changes.

Please feel free to contact us directly at crm@thekingsburyhotel.com for any further assistance or to discuss your experience.

We hope you will give us another chance to restore your faith in our service.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: André Marques
text:
Overall, great hotel, where we ended our 18-day tour around Sri Lanka. Since we had a bad experience with the previous hotel, where we didn’t like the room booked by our travel company, we asked right away for an upgrade to a suite since I saw there were still suites available on booking sites. Glad we did. The room was spacious, the bed was comfortable and we even had a washing machine (option to wash and dry your laundry; but no detergent available so bring your own if you intend using it). We just didn’t understand why two upgrade prices were announced by different people, that seemed odd…
Anyway, apart from that, the staff was professional, the lobby is huge and you can find there 3 restaurants (and another one on the rooftop). We chose the buffet one, which was rather expensive (we payed over 80 euros for 2 persons with a beer, a bottle of water and a juice), but there were lots of options and the food was very good (lots of cheese options and delicious desserts! try the date cake and the banana crumble!).
We also went to the pool, but it wasn’t very comfortable. The music was very (too!) loud and with a playlist that seemed more suited to a teenage party with bad taste. Not chill at all and not 5-starish at all. Also, part of the pool was under maintenance that seemed to take forever. There was also not enough shade and you can’t move the umbrellas (and there are so many tables and chairs that you can’t move too much your sunbeds neither).
The problem with the loud music went on during the night. The sound isolation was terrible even on the 5th floor and we heard the music blasting until very late.
If they could improve the pool area (more shade, less tables and chairs taking up space, and especially no music or a more quieter one and with a suitable volume), that would be great.
If you want to take a walk, it’s quite nice to the south near the beach, where you can also find a shopping centre if needed.
Both the hotel and that shopping centre have a security system and demand to scan your bag, by the way.

We would definitely recommend this hotel but improve the pool area and change the playlist or the DJ.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear André,

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback! We're glad to hear you enjoyed your stay overall and that the suite upgrade made a positive difference. We also appreciate your comments on the buffet and the food offerings, as well as your valuable insights regarding the pool area. Rest assured, we will take your suggestions into consideration to improve our guests' experience, especially regarding the music and pool ambiance.

We hope to welcome you back soon for another relaxing stay!

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Manu Herath
text: We stayed a couple nights during NYE and it was an experience. When we arrived for check-in, we were told our rooms were not ready yet and asked to wait another 30 mins...2 hours later we finally got our rooms. We hoped this would be the only misstep during our stay, but unfortunately it got worse! The NYE event at their Sky Lounge was terribly mismanaged: tables were ignored to the point where guests flagged down servers with phone flashlights, and the food was INCREDIBLY late (appetizer we ordered at 8:30 pm didn't arrive until 10 pm) and often the wrong dish so it would be sent back. The hotel itself is beautiful (though the rooms could use a little facelift) and the food is divine, but it's very clear there needs to be an overhaul in proper staff training and management -- we will probably stay at the Shangri-La next time instead because of this. We were compensated for our poor experience with a free dinner at the Harbour Court restaurant, which was nice but just wish it hadn't come down to that.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Manu,

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Nicole Peiris
text:
Our experience at The Kingsbury Hotel was nothing short of fantastic. Over a period of three weeks, we stayed there on and off while visiting Sri Lanka, using the hotel as our base in Colombo. The staff’s dedication to making our stay comfortable was truly remarkable, and they went above and beyond to ensure every detail was perfect.

We were visiting from the USA, and it was my elderly uncle’s first time back in Sri Lanka in 15 years. The staff, including Jayan, Johil, Manjula, and the General Manager Mahesh, treated us like family. They were especially accommodating of my 80-year-old uncle, ensuring all his needs were met. When he fell ill right before our flight back to the US, they were incredibly attentive and helped us navigate the situation with care and professionalism.

Their thoughtfulness extended to helping us arrange a larger van for a weekend trip to Bentota when I accidentally booked a smaller one. One standout moment was when Johil and another staff member assisted me with draping a saree—a thoughtful gesture that truly made my day. Additionally, the two housekeepers on the 4th floor, where we stayed most of the time, were phenomenal. Their attention to detail and kindness added so much to our experience.

The dining options were equally impressive. From the incredible variety and quality of food at Harbour Court to the breathtaking atmosphere at the Sky Lounge and Tenku, every meal was a treat. The chefs at Harbour Court were particularly considerate, offering my uncle excellent low-sodium options to suit his dietary needs.

The Kingsbury Hotel truly felt like a home away from home. Their exceptional service, warm hospitality, and meticulous care made our trip unforgettable. We can’t wait to return and highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Colombo.

Thank you to everyone at The Kingsbury for making our stay so memorable!
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nicole,

Thank you for your heartwarming review! We're thrilled to hear that your experience at The Kingsbury was memorable and that our team could make your visit special, especially for your uncle. Your kind words about our staff, dining options, and hospitality mean the world to us. We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Colombo!

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: James Warhurst
text:
We stayed 3 nights, it's time to review. We have mixed feelings about this hotel. Why some elements are worthy of the 5 stars. Other areas are really lacking. I'll start with  Rooftop bar is good but not great very forgetful with orders but staff very friendly. Breakfast and dinner are very good in terms of plenty of choice and tasty. But some service members let it down again just forgetting that you have asked for coffee or tea. It can be a slow process getting a cup of coffee to your table in the morning.The tea room with cake and pastries is excellent quality and great value. Again yesterday afternoon asked for tea for 3 from a young man twenty minutes later still no tea. The independent restaurants are very expensive. The Steakhouse and Japanese is outrageously priced.
General inspection around hotel, it's starting to look tired. The rooms could do with a re vamp a paint and a good clean with better linen. Carpet not a good idea looks filthy. Bed is comfortable.The pool area has to be the biggest negative. Looks very tired, the back of the hotel needs rendering a painted. The pool has loads of tiles missing the hydro spa under maintenance, no where near enough sunbeds for the demand but loads of tables and chairs taking space not being used. No bins around pool area for rubbish. Why not? A lot of staff standing around doing nothing and service is average. A glass bottle of water blew over yesterday, nobody looked interested in cleaning it up with my children and others walking around barefoot. We cleaned it ourselves after asking 3 different staff members. I've stayed in better 3 stars when it comes to the the pool area. It's looking very tired. I'm sure if I came back this time next year, the pool area would be no different and still with a sign "under maintenance" The crows are annoying also hanging around scavenging drinks or food. Very over staffed and managed this hotel, with this in mind the service should be only 5 star but isn't. Why do you need 4 men to handout pool towels??? This is a 4 star hotel in my opinion. All in all it's been a nice finish to our time in Sr Lanka but this place has much need for improvement to be anywhere near to being 5 stars. Also Check in and check out far to slow.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear James,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We're grateful for your detailed observations, and we sincerely apologize for the inconveniences you experienced. Your comments regarding the service, pool area, and room conditions have been noted, and we’ll work on making improvements in these areas. We take pride in offering a 5-star experience, and your feedback helps us improve. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future for a more seamless stay.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Cristina Ramos
text:
Complaint Regarding Unsatisfactory Stay – 4/01/25 in  The Kingsbury Colombo
48 Janadhipathi Mawatha
Colombo 00100
Sri Lanka

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with my recent stay at The Kingsbury Colombo on 04/01/25]. After a long journey from Lisbon to Sri Lanka, we arrived at the hotel around 9:30 AM, exhausted and in need of rest.

We were assigned a subpar room overlooking the pool. From 11:00 AM to 10:30 PM, there was extremely loud music coming from the pool area, making it impossible to rest. Despite our repeated complaints to the hotel staff, no effective action was immediately  taken to resolve the issue. Only at 9:30 pm when we were desperate to sleep.

I find it unacceptable that, knowing there would be events with loud music in the pool area, guests were accommodated in adjacent rooms without any prior notice or consideration for their comfort. This situation significantly compromised our experience and rest, contrary to the expectations we had regarding the service of a hotel of your category.

I will like to ask for a refund.  It is not unacceptable what they did. I will not recommend this hotel.

Disappointed with the Decline in Standards

I recently stayed at The Kingsbury, a hotel I used to admire for its exceptional service and quality (2013–2017). Unfortunately, my recent experience fell far short of expectations.

Despite having a confirmed reservation email, my booking was not recognized upon arrival. This resulted in a two-hour wait in the lobby with two children, after which I was charged an additional $50. The lobby and reception were chaotic due to wedding events, causing delays and discomfort for guests.

The staff appeared more focused on offering luggage services to earn tips rather than providing genuine, professional assistance. While I have no issue with tipping for excellent service, professionalism and guest care must come first.

Additionally, the elevators were overcrowded, making it challenging for residents to access their rooms efficiently.

It’s disappointing to see such a decline in quality. The Kingsbury once set a high standard for hospitality, but it now seems poorly managed and unorganized. I hope the management takes steps to improve the service and restore the hotel’s former reputation.
@Dhammika Perera
@Christine Chevalaz
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Peters,
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We deeply regret the inconvenience and frustration you faced during your recent stay. This is certainly not the level of service we aim to provide, and we sincerely apologize for the shortcomings you encountered.

Your concerns regarding the reservation mix-up, lobby experience, staff professionalism, and elevator congestion have been noted and will be addressed with the relevant teams. We are committed to taking corrective measures to ensure such issues are not repeated.

Please feel free to reach out to us directly at crm@thekingsburyhotel.com so we can address your concerns further.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo Team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Dhanushka T Weerawardhana
text:
The Kingsbury Hotel in Colombo, Sri Lanka, is a luxurious 5-star property offering a sophisticated and elegant experience for both business and leisure travelers. Situated along the scenic Galle Face Green, with beautiful views of the Indian Ocean, the hotel combines classic grandeur with modern amenities, making it a popular choice for those seeking comfort and convenience in Sri Lanka’s capital.

Upon entering the Kingsbury, guests are greeted with a sense of opulence, with its spacious lobby, high ceilings, and refined décor. The hotel's interiors feature a mix of contemporary style and timeless elegance, making for an inviting and pleasant atmosphere. The staff are warm, attentive, and highly professional, offering exceptional service throughout a guest's stay.

The rooms at The Kingsbury are spacious, well-appointed, and designed with comfort in mind. Many rooms offer stunning ocean views, while others overlook the vibrant cityscape of Colombo. The rooms are equipped with modern amenities such as high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and luxurious bedding. The bathrooms are equally impressive, featuring marble surfaces, rain showers, and premium toiletries.

One of the standout features of The Kingsbury is its dining options. The hotel boasts a variety of restaurants, each offering a unique experience. The Ocean Terrace, with its stunning oceanfront view, serves an array of international and Sri Lankan dishes, while the Italian-inspired Graze Kitchen offers a fine-dining experience. The hotel's stylish bar, The Lounge, is perfect for evening cocktails, while the popular Cakes and Bakes café offers a delightful selection of pastries and snacks.

The Kingsbury also offers an array of leisure facilities, including an outdoor pool with panoramic views of the city and ocean, a fully equipped fitness center, and a spa offering relaxing treatments. The hotel’s central location makes it convenient for guests to explore Colombo’s attractions, including the Gangaramaya Temple, Galle Face Green, and the National Museum, which are all just a short drive away.

While The Kingsbury provides a high standard of service and luxury, some guests have noted that certain areas, such as the spa and some aspects of the hotel's upkeep, could benefit from further attention. However, these minor shortcomings do little to detract from the overall positive experience.

In conclusion, The Kingsbury Hotel offers a luxurious and comfortable stay in the heart of Colombo. With its excellent service, top-notch facilities, and stunning views, it is an ideal choice for those looking for a high-end hotel in Sri Lanka's bustling capital. Whether for a short stay or a longer visit, guests are sure to enjoy a memorable and pleasant experience at this prestigious hotel.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Dhanushka,

Thank you for your wonderful and detailed review of The Kingsbury Hotel. We are delighted to hear that you had an exceptional experience, from the luxurious rooms to our attentive service and dining options. We also appreciate your constructive feedback regarding certain areas, and we will certainly look into them to ensure an even better experience for future guests.

We look forward to welcoming you back to The Kingsbury for another memorable stay.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo Team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Haleem Haris
text:
To start with The Victorian Banquet Hall Manager who was working on 05th December  (evening shift) was impolite,rude and didn't have the basic empathy.

I wonder how they were recruited for hospitality industry.

The event was for my sister we were informed to be at 3 pm in the receiving bay for the wedding starting at 6.30.

The receiving bay area of Kingsbury has a long walk for us to take stuff to the Victorian Hall, initially we were not prioritised neither no one informed us to come earlier than 3 pm (despite when we asked of we can come early they said no) even after when we informed the banquet hall manager to speak and help us get the space in receiving bay area to atleast unload the stuff they said they cannot even make efforts for it despite there is a wedding is going to happen. They were unloading grocery items. (If they would have given 20 mins time we could've unloaded everything) There is no priority basis on the receiving bay.

No trolly was given to us

The lift was rushed and some managers were supporting there event suppliers even to an extent of holding the lift

So I understood even if the Victorian Banquet Hall manager wanted he could've made efforts.

While we were getting the stuff to 10th floor it was around 5pm we have only 1 1/2 hours to do a Full wedding setup which has so many inclusions we rushed and due to the factor we had very little time we had it was not 100%

Some of the electric ports are not working when we notified the manager he said the electrician will come and no electrician came even when we went back after the event.

I'm writing this to atleast make sure to educate the staff with proper manners and customer service.

Being in the hospitality trade this is very disgusting to even experience.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Haleem,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent experience at The Kingsbury. We deeply regret to hear that certain aspects of your visit did not meet your expectations. Please accept our sincere apologies for the inconveniences you faced.

Your concerns about the service provided by our team, the challenges at the receiving bay, and the other logistical issues have been taken very seriously. We understand the importance of seamless coordination and attentive service, especially during such significant events, and we are truly sorry for any distress this caused.

We assure you that we will address your concerns with our team and take the necessary measures to ensure such incidents are not repeated. Providing our guests with exceptional service is our priority, and we are committed to continuous improvement to meet and exceed expectations.

Thank you for also highlighting the positives of your stay, such as the quality of our rooms and location. We hope to have the opportunity to restore your confidence in us and provide you with a more enjoyable experience in the future.

Warm regards,
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

text:
Kingsberry Hotel in Colombo is an exceptional place to stay, offering an experience that seamlessly blends luxury, comfort, and warm hospitality. From the moment you arrive, the welcoming staff ensures you feel valued, providing attentive service with genuine smiles. The check-in process is smooth and efficient, setting the tone for a delightful stay.

The hotel’s location is ideal, situated in the heart of Colombo, making it convenient for both business and leisure travelers. Attractions, shopping areas, and the city’s vibrant cultural sites are easily accessible, yet the hotel manages to maintain a tranquil ambiance.

The rooms at Kingsberry Hotel are spacious, well-appointed, and elegantly designed. Each room features plush beds, modern amenities, and breathtaking views of either the cityscape or the Indian Ocean. Cleanliness is a top priority, and it’s evident in every aspect, from the immaculate bathrooms to the fresh linens.

Dining at Kingsberry Hotel is a gastronomic adventure. The hotel’s restaurants serve a wide variety of cuisines, from traditional Sri Lankan dishes to international delights, all prepared with the freshest ingredients. The breakfast buffet is especially notable, offering a rich selection that caters to every taste.

Facilities at the hotel are excellent, including a beautiful outdoor pool, a well-equipped fitness center, and serene spa services for ultimate relaxation. The pool area is a perfect oasis to unwind, with attentive staff on hand to provide refreshments.

Overall, Kingsberry Hotel Colombo delivers an outstanding experience that combines luxury and authentic Sri Lankan hospitality. Whether you are visiting for business or leisure, the hotel provides everything you need for a memorable stay. I highly recommend Kingsberry Hotel to anyone seeking comfort, exceptional service, and a prime location in Colombo. You won't be disappointed!
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Rusira,

Thank you for your detailed and wonderful feedback! We’re thrilled to know you enjoyed every aspect of your stay, from the service and location to the dining and facilities. title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Bharatvir Singh
text:
I recently stayed at this beautiful and luxurious hotel that everyone raves about in the city and I definitely wanted to check it out myself. I travelled from Galle and pampered myself to a two night stay at The Kingsbury.

The hotel is grand and very welcoming to smiling faces of staff working there and showering their warm hospitality upon everyone. The hotel was busy which was great for the business and team were on their toes to ensure a great experience for everyone staying or visiting.

Coming to the positives -

1. Food was outstanding everywhere. Tried 4-5 outlets throughout the stay and the food and hospitality at the F&B outlets was divine specially at Yue Chuan and Tenku. The F&B team was great and chefs really definitely did put their heart and soul into the cooking.

2. Spa at the hotel was amazing. Really professional therapists and the team at the reception was truly welcoming and ensured a great experience during the therapies. I did have a suggestion and have already mentioned it to the spa team and that is to keep some loofahs at the spa on request for those guests to do choose to take a shower there itself.

3. Gymnasium was well equipped and definitely maintained to a great standard.

Unfortunately there were a few hiccups as well.

1. First and foremost , I was actually given a key to an occupied room on arrival. The guest occupying the room was lady and she was getting her makeup done when I walked in assuming she must be at the hotel for an event. However it was very embarrassing for both of us as she was in the middle of getting ready and I just invaded her privacy unknowingly. I definitely apologised for the inconvenience and went back to the reception and did let the team know. They mentioned that due to Houskeeping’s negligence, the room was marked ready as per their system. I hope they did speak to the guest and made sure everything was fine ! It was surely a very big inconvenience to the guest occupying the room and myself ! Unfortunately nothing was done post that by the team with regard to the same.

2. I had placed my order for lunch through room service upon arrival in the new room however the team member who delivered the food requested for the payment to be done at the same time rather than posting it to the room. It was actually the case for all the outlets I visited and none of them billed the checks to the room. Unfortunately not all the in-house guests like to carry their credit cards along to every space of the hotel they visit. Looked quite odd but that might just be the hotel policy unfortunately it was not informed upon arrival.

3. I had placed an order through the beach club for lunch on the day of departure which took about an hour and a half to be delivered to the room. I had reconfirmed with the employee at the beach club about the delivery and he over excitedly mentioned to have it served without an issue within 20-25 minutes. However after two follow-ups once through the reception and second through the room service, the order was finally served.

There were a few ups and downs about The Kingsbury however overall what I had heard off about the service and hospitality unfortunately that little spark was missing which could have definitely elevated the entire stay experience i was hoping for !
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mr. Bharatvir Singh,

Thank you for taking the time to share your recent experience at The Kingsbury. We appreciate your feedback and are committed to ensuring that every guest enjoys a memorable stay.

We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our food, spa services, and gym facilities. Our team strives to provide exceptional experiences in all areas, and we are glad that these aspects met your expectations.

We apologize sincerely for the inconvenience caused by the room mix-up upon your arrival. This was an unfortunate error, and we have taken steps to prevent such incidents from happening again. We will also ensure that our housekeeping team receives additional training to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

Regarding the room service and beach club orders, we apologize for the delays you experienced. We understand that prompt service is essential, and we will investigate these matters to identify the root causes and take corrective action.
 
Additionally, we apologize for any inconvenience caused by our payment policy. We will review this to offer a more guest-friendly approach and to ensure guests are informed at check-in.

We are committed to continuous improvement and learning from your feedback. We would like to invite you to contact us directly so that we can discuss your experience further and explore ways to make your next stay even more memorable.

Thank you again for choosing The Kingsbury. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Sincerely,
The Kingsbury Team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Thisitha Saveen
text:
We had a very bad experience on our wedding day (14/07/2024) at the Kingsbury Hotel. The front door staff and managers at the Kingsbury started a fight with the Ashtaka service (Charithra Wedding Services). The Kingsbury security didn't allow them to use the front door to enter, and the situation escalated quickly. Our wedding day coordinator from Kingsbury, Shaun Bernard, never mentioned any front door rules to us. If he had, we could have informed Charithra Wedding Services about them.

We faced a similar issue with the marquee letter delivery. Kingsbury didn't allow us to bring them through the front door. Fortunately, my brother was there and carried them all alone through the back door to the wedding hall (Victorian Hall, 10th floor). Our wedding entrance was planned to start at 10:30 am. I (the groom) went to take some photos on the ground floor with my vehicle as requested by the photographers. It was around 10:15 am. As I was nearing the front door, I heard a loud noise and a fight. Initially, I didn't pay much attention as I was in a rush to take photos and go to the 10th floor to start the entrance event. But then I realized that the fight was between the Kingsbury management and the Ashtaka service. The Kingsbury top management was yelling at the Ashtaka person for some reason and asking them to leave the premises. There were only 15 minutes left before the event started. I was exhausted and scared because all our sacrifices for the past two to three months and our wedding day could have been ruined. I begged them to stop the fight and continue the event. We had made full payments to both Kingsbury Hotel and Charithra Wedding Services, yet both acted like children, yelling at each other. Fortunately, the Ashtaka person took a step back and decided to continue the event. I was shaking for another half hour thinking about that even during the Poruwa ceremony. It was the worst experience on our wedding day. The Kingsbury staff was not helpful at all.

The Kingsbury wedding coordinator, Shaun, was either busy or pretended to be busy all the time. He wasn't even present on the wedding day morning at Kingsbury. The Kingsbury staff didn't know their own rules. Some said one thing while others totally disagreed, making it really difficult to handle on a big day like a wedding. The wedding hall staff was also not punctual. We asked them to arrange tables and serve dry bites, wedding cakes, and welcome drinks by 10:30 am. However, they served them around 11:50 am, despite us asking several times.

I'm posting this to give an idea to couples planning their big day at this hotel. If you do, please ask about every single rule in the hotel, as they didn't inform us of any of them prior to the wedding, making it really difficult to manage during the event. Even if you ask, many of them don’t answer properly. The managers have really poor management abilities. I have never seen managers act like that in such a situation.

We were really lucky to have our parents and brothers help us overcome all those problems and conduct our wedding day perfectly. But if the Poruwa people had left, our day would have been ruined. The Kingsbury management was the worst at handling such situations.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mr. Saveen,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are genuinely sorry to hear about your recent experience during your wedding ceremony at The Kingsbury, and sincerely apologise for any disappointment or inconvenience caused.

Please know that your concerns are being taken very seriously. We are committed to addressing this issue promptly and will have a senior member of our team reach out to you directly to discuss your experience in more detail and work towards a satisfactory resolution.

Once again, our sincerest apologies for the trouble you have encountered. We value your feedback as it helps us to continuously improve our services.

Best Regards,
The Kingsbury Colombo

name: RSK
text: I spent ten nights at this hotel on holiday as a solo traveller and overall had a positive experience. The staff were consistently polite and kind, always greeting guests with a smile. Housekeeping services were satisfactory, and the maintenance team was excellent – a fault with my air conditioning was addressed within five minutes of reporting it to guest services. The gym was well-equipped, though a small group of guests using it as a dance rehearsal space with loud music made it unusable for me on a couple of occasions. Rooms were clean and tidy, but perhaps on the smaller side compared to other five-star establishments in Colombo. It was frustrating that all in-room dining orders had to be paid for immediately, with no option to charge them to the room bill – even the front desk staff were unable to assist with this. name: Sadman Dhruba
text:
It was an extraordinary dining experience! The highlight of my meal was the tuna steak, which was absolutely divine.

Dining Experience:
Dining poolside at The Kingsbury is a true delight. The serene setting with the gentle sound of water, coupled with the warm lighting and elegant decor, creates a relaxing and luxurious atmosphere. It’s the perfect spot for a leisurely evening meal, offering beautiful views and a tranquil environment.

Tuna Steak:
The tuna steak I had was nothing short of exceptional. Cooked to perfection, it was seared on the outside while remaining tender and flavorful on the inside. The seasoning was just right, enhancing the natural flavors of the tuna without overpowering them. It was served with a delightful accompaniment of fresh vegetables and a tangy sauce that complemented the dish beautifully. Every bite was a testament to the chef's skill and attention to detail.

Overall Experience:
While I didn't stay at The Kingsbury, my dining experience alone was enough to make a lasting impression. The combination of the exquisite tuna steak, the elegant setting, and the top-notch service made for a memorable evening. Whether you're staying at the hotel or just looking for a fantastic meal in Colombo, I highly recommend dining at The Kingsbury. It's a culinary experience you won't want to miss!
responseFromOwnerText:

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Pesala Jayasuriya
text:
During my recent visits to Kingsbury Colombo, I was thoroughly impressed with every aspect of this stunning hotel. From casual visits for coffee and beer to attending grand wedding celebrations, Kingsbury has consistently provided a memorable experience.

Starting with the daily essentials, Kingsbury is a fantastic spot for grabbing a coffee. Not only is the price reasonable, but the atmosphere in which you enjoy your brew makes it all the more worthwhile. It's the perfect place to unwind after a day’s work or to catch up with friends over a good cup of coffee. The setting is serene, and the vibe is just right for a relaxing evening.

My lunch experience at the Harbour Court Restaurant was equally commendable. The buffet offered an extensive variety of both local and international dishes, each prepared to perfection. The freshness of the ingredients and the chef’s attention to detail in flavor and presentation greatly enhanced the dining experience. This restaurant truly stands out not just for the quality of the food, but also for its elegant atmosphere and splendid views, making every meal feel special.

Additionally, Honey Beach Club at Kingsbury is the ultimate go-to for a chilled beer. The beachside ambiance combined with the soothing sound of waves and the cool breeze creates an idyllic setting to enjoy a good brew. It’s a refreshing escape from the bustling city life, ideal for relaxing evenings.

The hotel's capability in handling events is impressive, as evidenced by the couple of weddings of friends that I attended here. The meticulous attention to detail, from the decor to the service, was remarkable. Each wedding was a showcase of elegance and seamless execution, making them memorable for all the right reasons.

The staff at Kingsbury deserves a special mention for their exceptional service. Always helpful and polite, they ensure that every visit is comfortable and enjoyable. The availability of parking adds to the convenience, making it easy for local guests to access the hotel’s amenities.

Overall, Kingsbury Colombo is not just a hotel, but a wonderful experience that combines luxury, comfort, and a welcoming atmosphere. Whether it's for a simple coffee, a gourmet meal, a relaxing beer, or a grand celebration, Kingsbury proves to be worth every penny. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a premium experience in Colombo!
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Pesala,

We're delighted to hear about your positive experiences at Kingsbury Colombo. Thank you for highlighting our coffee spot, Harbour Court Restaurant, and Honey Beach Club, as well as our exceptional event handling capabilities. We're glad you enjoyed the serene atmosphere, extensive variety of dishes, and attentive service provided by our staff. Your recommendation is greatly appreciated, and we look forward to welcoming you back for more memorable experiences in the future!

Warm regards, 
The Kingsbury, Colombo team

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Monica Foong
text:
***Please beware of tourist scams outside the front of the hotel***

Absolutely no complaints about our stay at the Kingsbury. We stayed for 3 nights and had a lovely time. Accessible to lots of local attractions. Staff always friendly, smiling and very helpful. Very clean and hotel restaurants and amenities were excellent.

A word of warning we were approached twice by people outside the hotel claiming to be staff. They were friendly and told us about so called local events to attend. Then their tuk tuk friend would conveniently appear to take us to a place. We didn’t get in the tuk tuk. Usually they take you to a place where things are really expensive eg tea or gems. Just beware as hotel staff are not allowed to approach you outside the hotel grounds and this is a common scam. The scammers can appear very friendly and helpful and offer lots of local tips.

For hotel feedback: Perhaps it would have been good at the time of check in if the reception staff gave us a heads up that this scam is common and not to trust anyone outside the hotel claiming to be hotel staff.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Monica,

Thank you for sharing your positive experience! We're delighted to hear that you had a lovely time during your 3-night stay at the Kingsbury. It's wonderful that you found our hotel accessible to local attractions and that our staff were always friendly, smiling, and helpful. Hier hat man einen super Überblick über Colombo und das Meer. Die Kellner in der Skylounge waren einfach nur Spitze und sehr gästeorientiert. Hier wurde einem jeder Wunsch erfüllt. Heiße Milch zum Kaffee und sei es auch schon 1 Uhr des Nachts. immer wieder gerne!
textTranslated: Located directly overlooking the container port in Colombo, this hotel is very easy to reach. The staff was exceptionally friendly and helpful. The room was great. Hot milk with coffee, even at 1 a.m. I'd be happy to come back anytime!

name: Justin Hart
text: Came here with family and whilst the lobby and restaurants appear nice I can tell you once you get off the lift into the hotel hallway it's anything but 5 stars. Upon leaving the lift you'll be greeted with cheap lighting and thick dirty carpet that smells like it should have been ripped up in the 70s. But wait it gets worse this hotel advertised itself as 5 stars but rooms resemble a 2 star truck stop. My room was dirty with old damaged lamps, thick dirty carpet, a bathroom that hadn't been cleaned  and lacking any basic essentials you'd accept from a 5 star hotel. Not only that but they didn't even have a working mini bar fridge. I accept d my fate and went out to explore the city, however when I returned to my room it smelt like sewage to the point I was dry reaching. After over an hour a manager appeared and offered me a new room after he himself almost threw up. I requested a refund and said I'd go to another hotel in which i was told that wouldn't be happening and if I left I'd still be charged.  Another horrible room with no mini bar fridge but at least it didn't smell like a septic tank. I asked for the hotel manager to get in contact with me the next morning as it was after 10pm by the time I was settled in a new room. However they never bothered. Upon checking out the customer experience manager was told about our complaint and said she'd contact us but guess what she never bothered either. All in all this is the worst 5 star hotel I've seen in any country in my life time and I wouldn't recommend it. I even reached out the the Kingsbury's parent company pre writing this review however they wouldn't give  me a response. Stay clear of these disgusting rooms at all costs. title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Mike Shubic (Mike's Road Trip)
text:
After spending a month traversing the beautiful landscapes of Sri Lanka, my stay at The Kingsbury Hotel in Colombo was undoubtedly a highlight. Nestled near the serene sea and situated right in the pulsating heart of the city, The Kingsbury is a gem that offers not only convenience, but luxury at an affordable price.

From the moment I stepped into the lobby, I was enveloped in an ambiance of elegance and comfort. The hotel's location is second to none, offering easy walking distance to a myriad of attractions that Colombo has to offer. Whether you're looking to explore the local culture, shop, or dine, everything is just a stone's throw away.

The rooms at The Kingsbury are a testament to luxurious living. Spacious, impeccably designed, and equipped with all the modern amenities one could ask for, my room provided a sanctuary of relaxation after days filled with exploration.

Dining at The Kingsbury is an experience in itself. The restaurant boasts a fantastic menu that caters to a wide array of palates, offering both local and international cuisine at its best. The complementary breakfast is a feast for the senses, providing a perfect start to the day with a variety of delicious options to choose from.

A standout feature of The Kingsbury is its rooftop bar. It's not just a place to grab a drink; it's a destination. With a sophisticated atmosphere, contemporary cocktails, and a breathtaking view of the city, it's the perfect spot to unwind and soak in the beauty of Colombo at night.

They also have a large pool area, and in the evening it transforms into a disco of sorts.

Moreover, the service at The Kingsbury is exemplary. The staff goes above and beyond to ensure guests have a memorable stay, with attention to detail and a willingness to assist in any way possible.

In summary, The Kingsbury Hotel is more than just a place to stay; it's an experience. Whether you're visiting Sri Lanka for business or pleasure, The Kingsbury offers the perfect blend of luxury, location, and service. It was, without a doubt, one of the best hotels I had the pleasure of staying at during my time in the country, and I cannot recommend it highly enough to anyone planning a visit to Colombo.

We came downstairs and contacted your F&B Managers , Mr Upul and Mr. Sandun Chinthaka , who went of their way to contact the engineering personnel Mr. Ranjan . They  stopped the lift for few minutes and Mr. Ranjan got my phone back . By God’s grace, my phone is in one piece and still working  .
I am truly amazed that your staff are so warm , courteous , encouraging and so helpful and they attended to my desperate plea at once . Hats off to your wonderful staff .
I loved my stay at  your hotel , the interiors are grand and elegant ; rooms are very plush ,comfortable and clean. The buffet at Harbour Court was excellent,  together with the many delicious desserts.
Thank you Kingsbury for everything !!

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Nipuna Wickramasinghe
text:
The Kingsbury hotel is a true gem nestled in the heart of the city. From the moment I arrived, I was captivated by its grandeur and sophistication. The lobby exudes elegance with its marble floors, soaring ceilings, and intricate chandeliers, setting the tone for a luxurious stay.

The check-in process was seamless, with the staff greeting me warmly and efficiently escorting me to my room. Speaking of which, the room itself was a haven of comfort and style. The plush bedding, tasteful decor, and modern amenities created a serene retreat after a long day of exploring the city.

One of the highlights of my stay was dining at the hotel's restaurants. Whether indulging in a sumptuous buffet breakfast at the all-day dining restaurant or savoring exquisite cuisine at the fine dining establishment, each meal was a culinary delight. The talented chefs showcased the finest local and international flavors, leaving me eager to return for more.

When it came time to unwind, the hotel's leisure facilities did not disappoint. I spent blissful hours relaxing by the rooftop pool, soaking in the breathtaking views of the city skyline. The fitness center was also well-equipped, allowing me to maintain my workout routine even while traveling.

But perhaps what truly sets the Kingsbury apart is its impeccable service. Throughout my stay, every staff member I encountered was attentive, gracious, and genuinely committed to ensuring my comfort and satisfaction. From arranging transportation to providing insider tips on local attractions, their hospitality truly made me feel like a valued guest.

In conclusion, my experience at the Kingsbury hotel was nothing short of exceptional. Whether you're visiting for business or leisure, this hotel offers a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and personalized service. I cannot recommend it highly enough and eagerly look forward to my next stay.

We're truly honoured to have had the opportunity to host you, and we eagerly look forward to welcoming you back for another unforgettable stay.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Noel Peries
text:
We stayed here for a few days on Mid Jan 24.

Pros
- staff very professional and polite
- breakfast was great with loads of options both European and Sri Lankan all done to a decent standard, our 3.5 year old daughter loved the pancakes and waffle station
- beds were super comfy
- The location is good to walk around and there is a decent shopping centre not far away with good food options
- there short eats/pastry shop was excellent and great to get some snacks over lunch or take on the road if doing a trip

Cons
- they had weddings here constantly while we were here and it gets chaotic in the reception area while guests and wedding parties move around
- they have two lifts and it's really not enough for the amount of people staying here so you end up waiting a while especially if a wedding is using the top floor
- one night a wedding party (we think) was playing really loud music and kept us awake till 2/3am not sure where the music was coming from but it was loud and pumping and we could hear it on the 8th floor
- swimming pool is ok but they also have a DJ on some evenings so it feels you can't really relax there because there are two different crowds who want to stay outside

So overall an ok stay for a few days but if you want something more peaceful then I would suggest a hotel in Negombo unless you need to be in the city for something

text:
I recently made a reservation for an event at the Victorian banquet hall, and unfortunately, my experience with the coordinator, Shaun Bernard, was disappointing. He provided inaccurate information about the changing rooms, claiming they could only be accessed after the event, despite the entitlement in the morning. Additionally, he insisted on an extra charge if we needed the changing rooms earlier.
In addition to the aforementioned issues, Shaun Bernard falsely claimed that other banquet halls were reserved for the day when, in fact, they were available. This misinformation added to the overall lack of trust and transparency in the coordinator's communication. It's disappointing when such misrepresentations impact the credibility of the venue and its staff.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: SHAFFAANKING
text:
I visited here in 2021 and left a 5 star review which got some attention, even by the management team of Kingsbury themselves. I am now here in 2024 and it is unfortunate to say this but I have a lot of concerns over this hotel now.

-Shortage of drinking water & unusual taste in drinking water.
I was told we get 3-4 bottles of water a day and they run out real quick. It is a small bottle and the average human requires 8 cups of water a day. Not only that but the water has an unusual taste whenever I drink it, it tastes like some sort of rot, I don't know how to explain it. You guys should really check your water tanks or whoever you get your purified water from.

-Lack of privacy in hotel bathroom & damaged bathroom lock in 2 rooms.
I resided in on one hotel room and other half of my family resided in another room. Both rooms bathroom door locks were damaged upon our arrival. By some luck we're able to lock the door in the other room but it took some time. Even then the bathroom door remains slightly opened (It is a sliding door). Any sound we make can be heard within the whole room so it is quite embarrassing and disturbing. The glass that is supposed to be censoring both sides barely makes any effect. We can still see through them (depends on how far away you are).

-Loud music from bars within the hotel.
As I write this review at night time, there is loud music playing. I am at the 9th floor yet it is that loud. We're a Muslim family and it is hard as we try to pray while we hear the loud music. It is really disturbing for us.

For a 5 star hotel to have these such issues, it is really concerning. I request the management to come up a solution for these problems.

Although, I kind of enjoyed my stay. The staff members were really kind. The pool and sauna was an amazing experience. I hope I get to visit this hotel soon, but this time with my mentioned concerns resolved.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: S D
text: We booked the Honey Beach Club for New Year's Eve and were not informed during the reservation that the pool would be closed on that day. Only on New Year's Eve itself, we received notice that the entire party was moved indoors to the ballroom. Quite disappointing, although the hotel can't control the weather. However, there were no discounts or compensation offered. The buffet was extensive but definitely not worth the money. Instead of the expected Beach Club Party, we found ourselves in a hall where the music, even for young people, was uncomfortably loud, and we paid 18,000RS per person, which is definitely too much for what was provided. The staff was friendly, but the service brought us the drinks bill without being asked, indicating poorly trained staff. The breakfast buffet consisted only of rice pudding, which doesn't justify the 18k per person cost. It seems like you're paying for appearance rather than substance. The hotel did not offer any price adjustments after moving the party indoors. Despite the canceled party, many guests, including us, accepted the overpriced offer, as there were no other plans for New Year's Eve. The hotel was aware of the guests' situation on New Year's Eve, which might explain the lack of compensation despite the canceled party. Another disappointment was the lack of any firework arrangements by the hotel, which had been promised to us beforehand. All in all I am really disappointed by the Kingsburry.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Ashane Wadasinghe
text:
On the 15th of December 2023 there was a Family Wedding that happened at the Kingsbury. And, 15 minutes to the ceremony, the event organizer, the coordinator, and a very popular Table Supplier, failed to provide the tables, to setup the location. While the auspicious Poruwa Ceremony was happening, with almost 150 guests, standing outside, the ballroom, was empty, with the florists waiting to setup the table decor. The table supplier was not answering the calls.

However, 10 minutes prior to the scheduled time, the table supplier came in with a part of the ordered quantity and we were understaffed, to place the setup, within the few minutes, left.

This was a surreal, dramatic moment, where, the staff of hotels, removed their jackets, rolled up the sleeves, and in a moment, started to bring in, the tables by storm. To add to that, teams from the Honey Beach and other Restaurants, joined, and within the brief 10 minutes we had, more than 35 tables were properly placed, inside the hall.

I want to thank the staff, and the management for such a well trained team, and more than any training the humanity they displayed at that moment of crisis.

title: The Kingsbury Colombo
name: Ran1992 Panchamee
text:
Im highly disappointment with the experience my family and I encountered at Kingsbury Harbour Court during the dinner buffet on the 3rd of December. We chose your establishment to celebrate my mother's 60th  birthday and unfortunately, the evening fell short of our expectations.

Upon inquiring at the reception about reservations, we were informed of two available time slots, 7 PM and 9 PM. Opting for the latter, we were assured by your staff that the food spread and refilling would be adequately managed.

Upon arrival,we encountered confusion at the appetizer corner where a yellow dish lacked a name tag. One of your assistant chefs initially identified it as pineapple but later contradicted himself by stating it was a fish dish.we were disheartened to find that certain dishes, notably the kottu, were already finished. Only after raising the issue to the manager did we receive attention and the kottu was eventually served at our table. I must commend Chef Sashi Kumar for his prompt action and accommodating demeanor during this incident.

This lack of clarity reflects poorly on the presentation and knowledge of your staff.

Throughout the evening, we had to continually remind the waiters to clear our plates. Furthermore, the cake cutting, an integral part of celebrating my mother's birthday, required three reminders before a waiter hastily delivered the cake without any ceremonial elements. In similar establishments, it is customary for a duty manager to accompany such moments with greetings or music, which unfortunately was absent from our experience.

Despite bringing these concerns to the attention of your Front Desk manager, we have yet to receive any feedback or resolution regarding our complaint.

We arrived at your esteemed establishment expecting a delightful evening to celebrate a special occasion. Regrettably, our experience did not meet the standards one would anticipate from a renowned 5-star hotel.

Thanks

Regards
R.Hettiarachchi
